title: «صوتك بيتحسب»
line: On a catch only the citizens who voted for the spy score; anyone who accused an innocent gets nothing that round. Every vote counts, and the bars before the reveal become everyone's own verdict.
warn: spy-games.md: «Caught and wrong, a point to every player»

title: «أنا الجاسوس» في النص
line: As in الموقع السري, the spy may stop the discussion at any time from a quiet button that is the same on every phone and pick the word from six: right is 3 points, wrong counts as caught. It gives the spy a bold move before the vote.

title: «مين يسأل مين؟» في الغرف
line: The one-phone ask director in rooms: the server walks the pairs (asked least, asks least) and every phone and the TV show «حسن يسأل منى» with «التالي» for the asker. The quiet ones get asked, and the spy can't stay silent.

title: «🎲 فئة مفاجأة»
line: A category option that draws a different spy category each round, landing on the TV and the phones with spinLetter as the round opens. Many evenings pass before the same kind comes back.

title: «الجاسوس التاني»
line: With two spies, catching one opens a second, shorter vote (60 s) among the rest to find the other; each caught spy gets their own six-word guess. A big table keeps hunting after the first catch.

title: قرعة أعدل للجاسوس
line: Whoever was the spy last round is half as likely to be dealt it again (RoomImposter.js and JS_Imposter.html deal uniformly, so one cousin can be the spy three times running). It is never impossible, so nobody can rule anyone out.

title: Reveal and re-check the card by holding it
line: Rooms: the reveal card stays open after one tap («🕵️ أنت الجاسوس» in its label) on a phone lying on the table, and once the discussion starts the word is gone. Make it a .hold-card like مافيا's (shows while pressed), and add a small «👁️ كلمتي» hold chip on the discussion and vote screens.
warn: spy-games.md «Every phone looks the same» (this keeps it: same card for every role)

title: The caught spy's six words: a grid with a confirm
line: renderImposterGuess sends roomAct('guess') on the first tap of a full-width row, so one slip ends the round, and six stacked rows run off a 667x375 screen. Draw them as a 2x3 grid of tiles (the cham-cell look), the first tap lifts a tile, «أكيد؟» confirms (as الحرباء's showConfirmModal does).

title: «شاف كارته» count on the reveal
line: While the cards are dealt the host can't tell who has looked yet. Each flip sends a quiet 'seen'; the reveal shows «٣/٥ شافوا» with the faces ticking (ltrFrac), and «ابدأ النقاش» glows once everyone has.

title: TV discussion: faces round the clock
line: The TV's discussion is a clock and one line. Put everyone's face (tvFaceAccent) in a ring round the clock, the first asker lit, so the table looks up at who's talking.

title: Shuffle the board every deal
line: Each of the 92 boards per language is exactly 16 words, and both the room and the one-phone deal keep their stored order, so «A1» is the same word every time a category comes back. Shuffle the 16 squares at deal time (the family pack already is).

title: «الإعادة» on a tie
line: Instead of the chameleon walking free on a tie, the tied players each say one more word and the table votes again between them only. The best scenes are that last word under pressure.
warn: spy-games.md: «a tie lets the impostor slip away»

title: «مين فضحها؟»
line: When the chameleon guesses right, they tap whose clue gave the word away; that player loses a point and wears «فضحتها» on the board. Players learn to give clever, not obvious, clues.

title: «حرباء صامتة»
line: A way to play where the clue is acted, not said: everyone does one gesture or sound for the secret word in turn. Same boards, great for kids and grandparents who freeze on words.

title: «ماحدش شك فيها»
line: A chameleon who escapes with zero votes on them scores 3 instead of 2; the vote bars show the empty bar lighting up last. A rare, perfect bluff gets its own moment.

title: Hold to see your word
line: In rooms the role card shows «🔑 the word» all round on phones lying face up, readable by the chameleon in the next seat. Make it a .hold-card (shown while pressed), the grid unchanged, the same for every role.
warn: spy-games.md «Every phone looks the same» (kept: one card for every role)

title: Whose turn to speak, lit
line: The «ترتيب الكلام» chips never move. Light the current speaker (is-turn) on phones and the TV; the speaker taps «قلت» (or the host/TV taps the chip) and the light slides on; after the last one «ابدأ التصويت» pulses.

title: Sideways: grid beside the card
line: At 667x375 the room screen stacks the head, role card, 4x4 grid, order and button, so the grid scrolls away. Put the grid on one side and the card, order and button in a compact column (the «play area gets the space» decision).

title: «وقّف!» كارت لكل واحد
line: Each player has one «وقّف!» per round: anyone may freeze the clock and accuse one person; everyone else answers yes/no, all must agree. If not, the clock runs on and that card is spent. The accusation belongs to the table, not the host.
warn: spy-games.md: the vote is opened by the host or by the clock

title: «جرأة الجاسوس»
line: A spy who stops to guess while nobody has accused them scores 3 if right; a caught spy who then guesses right gets only 1; escaping stays 2. The bold guess is worth it.

title: «+١ دقيقة»
line: The host gets +1 minute on the clock (as مافيا's moreTime) when the questions are good, on the phone and the TV.

title: «أماكن من بلدنا»
line: Tag the 84 places that are everyday Egypt (قهوة بلدي, ميكروباص, فلوكة, مولد شعبي, سوق خضار…) and offer «من بلدنا بس» in the setup: familiar places for kids and grandparents, from the same list.

title: The first asker by a face roulette
line: Who asks first spins through the faces on the TV and phones and lands (spinLetter over names) instead of a line of text. A small show opens every round.

title: «من غير وقت» for kids
line: A clock option of none (the host opens the vote), as الجاسوس's limit can be off: little ones don't panic at a red clock.

title: The spy's guess mode must look different
line: «🕵️ أنا الجاسوس» turns the same chip card from crossing out to guessing, and only the eyebrow text changes. In guess mode tint the card's border with --danger, change the hint, and pin «إلغاء» in the sticky bar so a spy doesn't guess thinking they're crossing out.
warn: spy-games.md: the spy's button is the same on every phone (only the guess mode, on the spy's phone, changes)

title: The 24 places as tiles with a counter
line: On a 375px phone the card is a long wall of name chips under the role card. Lay them as two-column tiles with the place's emoji big, and a «شطبت ٩/٢٤» counter; the clock badge sticks in the play head.

title: TV: a board of places and a ring clock
line: The TV shows the 24 as small chips under a text clock. At 1280/1920 draw them as a 6x4 board with big emoji and the clock in the emptying ring the one-phone talk uses.

title: Result lines, one fact each
line: The room result packs place · accused · guess into one subtitle line that wraps badly in Arabic at 375. Three labelled rows: 📍 المكان, 🗳️ اتهمتوا, 🎯 خمّن.

title: No voting for yourself
line: advanceFakeArtistTurn opens the vote with options that have no ownerId, so castVote never refuses a vote for yourself and renderBallot shows your own name. Add ownerId: id as الجاسوس, الحرباء and الموقع السري do.

title: The line drawn live
line: Send the drawer's line as it is drawn (Room.sendLive, as ارسم وخمّن does) so the TV and phones watch it grow. The fake's slow, careful line is half the fun.

title: «اختار من ٦» for the caught fake
line: A level for kids: the caught fake picks the word from six of the same category (as الجاسوس) instead of typing it; typing stays the default for experts.

title: «خط في ٦ ثواني»
line: An option where each line must be drawn in one go within 6 seconds of touching the canvas. No careful mini-drawings, so the fake can't hide behind a slow perfect line.

title: «اللفة العكسية»
line: The second lap runs in reverse order, so whoever drew last draws first again. The fake who sat comfortably at the end has to open the second lap.
warn: draw.md: the order is fully random so the fake may open (owner, 22 Sep 2026)

title: TV result with the vote bars
line: The TV result jumps to the word and the scoreboard. Use roomSpyVoteBars with the fake's bar rising last, spyRevealParts's cover over «الفنان المزيف كان…», and the living spy after it, as the three spy games' TVs do.

title: Sideways: the canvas takes the height
line: At 667x375 the role card (word in metric--md and the category chip) and the turn header sit above the square canvas, pushing it below the fold on your turn. Sideways, put the card, legend and Send in a side column and let the canvas fill the height.

title: «بعدك إنت» on the next drawer's phone
line: Only the current drawer's chip is lit. Show «بعدك إنت» on the next drawer's phone (and a soft dot on their chip) so they look at the drawing before their turn comes.

title: «حكاية الليالي» at the end
line: After the roles flip, the TV and phones replay the game night by night: the Mafia's target, the doctor's save, the detective's check (flyEmoji between faces), then each day's vote bars. The table finally learns who nearly died.

title: The out players see everything
line: A player who is out gets a spectator view: every role and, at night, every pick as it is made (still silent, and their phone can't talk or vote). Being out becomes a front-row seat, not a wait.

title: «الحارة بتنام» on the TV
line: The night on the TV is a street of houses, one per living player, unnamed and shuffled, whose lights go out one by one as the tapped count rises; in the morning the house of whoever left has its door open. It still shows nobody's role.
warn: mafia.md: the TV at night shows a count, not names (kept: houses are unnamed and in random order)

title: «اتهام وتأييد»
line: A way to run the day: someone names a suspect, a second player must back it within 10 s, and the accused gets 20 s on the TV; only the backed names go on the ballot. Order for a big table.
warn: mafia.md owner's spec: a discussion clock before every vote (this structures it)

title: Points by role
line: On the winning side, +1 more to the Detective who found a Mafia, the Doctor for each save, and the last Mafia standing. Playing your role well counts, not only being on the side that won.

title: The doctor saves themself once
line: A rule switch: the Doctor may protect themself only once a game, so a Doctor can't simply hide behind themself every night.

title: Day screen: news first, people next
line: At 375 the day stacks the news, a discussion card that only repeats the heading, the people, the role card and the buttons. Fold the heading into the news card with the clock, and bring the people list up.

title: «مفيش حد» apart from the names
line: In the vote «🤷 مفيش حد» is one more row in the same style as the names. Put it under a hairline as a ghost button so nobody taps it by mistake, and show it as its own grey bar in the results.

title: Faces, not text chips
line: The people list on the phone and the TV is plain name chips. Use the lobby stage's faces (tvFaceAccent), those still in big, those out greyed with the role they were shown as, so the TV reads from the sofa.

title: Say that a pick can change
line: After a night tap the line says «اختيارك اتسجل», and nobody knows they can still change it until night ends. Add «تقدر تغيّره لحد ما الليل يخلص» on every phone (the same words for every role).

title: Clue inside a word
line: giveClue compares whole folded words only. Also refuse a clue that contains an unturned board word, or is contained in one (folded with normaliseClue, 3+ letters), so «شجر» can't point at «شجرة».

title: «كان قصدي…»
line: With the clue the spymaster may quietly tap the cards they meant; at the end each clue in the log shows meant against turned on the phones and the TV («قصدي الأسد، لفّيتوا الدبابة»). The laughs come after the game.

title: «القاتل الرحيم»
line: A gentle level: the black card ends the turn and hands the other team one of its own cards instead of losing the game. Kids can play without one unlucky tap ending it all.

title: Agree and it turns
line: When every operative of the team in play has marked the same card, it turns after a 2-second ring (any unmark stops it). A team that agrees needs no second press.

title: «تلات فرق»
line: For 9+ people, a third team (green) on a 6x5 board with its own spymaster: the turn goes round three sides. A big family plays together, not as two crowds.

title: A swapped word that is new
line: swapWord picks Math.random() from the whole list, so a word from the last board can come straight back. Take it from what nextPrompts hasn't dealt lately.

title: The number as chips, not a select
line: The count is a <select> with an inline width:84px (a one-off style). Use a .segmented row of 1 2 3 4 ∞ with «أكتر» opening 0 and 5-9, default 1, under a full-width clue field.

title: Guesses left as pips
line: The banner says «محاولات متبقية: 3» in text. Show pips that drop as cards turn, the bonus +1 pip faded, on the phone and the TV.

title: Words that fit their card
line: Five columns at 375px cut long Arabic words. Fit each card's text (shrink a step, up to two lines), and at 667x375 put the board beside the clue and controls column.

title: «فاضل لينا» for the spymaster
line: Under the board, the spymaster sees their team's unturned words as chips, so they plan the next clue without scanning 25 coloured cards.

title: «قول الكلمة» from the big lists
line: A kind of mission built at deal time: «خلّي {target} يقول كلمة «{word}»», the word dealt from DRAW_WORDS or the spy categories through nextPrompts. Endless talking missions that fit any place and company, with no new list.

title: Catch the mission too
line: After a right «كشفتك!», the catcher may guess the mission from three (the real one and two of the same place) for +1 more. A good catch is also a good read.

title: «الملفات اتلخبطت»
line: The host can shuffle every target at once, stamped on the TV and every 📁; everyone's suspicion starts over. It livens up a slow hour.

title: The reveal as the program's last act
line: When برنامج السهرة reaches its finale with the mission on, the cork-board reveal plays as its last act, before the podium.
warn: mission.md: «Not hooked to برنامج السهرة's finale» (open to change)

title: «الملف ده قديم»
line: A file untouched for 25 minutes gets a gentle nudge on its doer's phone and a free «غيّرها» that doesn't count against the 10 minutes, so the quiet ones get a mission they can do.

title: «كشفتك!» in two taps
line: missionCatch sends on the first tap of a face. The first tap should lift the face, then a stamp «كشفتك يا منى!» confirms with «لأ، استنى» beside it, as أسماء الرموز's second press does.

title: The file sideways
line: At 667x375 the open file (paper, tally, the stamps, the catch row) is a tall modal that scrolls under a held finger. Sideways, the paper on one side and the stamps and names on the other.

title: A count for memos, a dot for a new file
line: The header 📁's dot means either a memo waiting for your yes/no or a file not yet opened. Show a number for memos waiting (they need you) and keep the dot for a new file.

title: «قرّب» من غير ما يتقري
line: Fix: a close guess shows its text only on the guesser's own phone; everyone else (and the TV) sees just «🔥 خالد قرّب». Today the near-spelling is printed for all, so the next person copies it and takes the 2 points.

title: ضربة سريعة
line: If the word is guessed in the first third of the clock, both the guesser and the drawer get +1 on top, shown as a ⚡ on the stamp - a clear drawing finally pays the drawer more than a muddle.

title: «قول الفئة»
line: A button for the drawer only: it reveals the word's kind from DRAW_WORD_CATS (drawWordCategory already exists) to the guessers, and the drawer gives up their point for the round - the drawer chooses between pride and getting the word across.

title: رسمة بإيدين
line: A lobby way where two drawers share one word and pass the pen every 10 seconds (the pen moves on the server's clock); neither may undo the other's strokes, so one draws a cat and the other turns it into a lion. Both score if it's guessed.

title: تخمين المتفرجين
line: Latecomers and anyone off the roster can type guesses too, marked 👀 on the list and on the TV, for no points - a cousin who just walked in is playing within ten seconds instead of waiting for the next game.

title: خانة التخمين فوق الكيبورد
line: On a 375px phone the guess field (#draw-guess) sits under the canvas and the iPhone keyboard covers the guesses list; while the field has focus, fit the canvas to the space left and keep the last 3 guesses as one line above the field, with enterkeyhint="send".

title: دور مين يرسم، واضح
line: The guessers' header should say «🎨 سارة بترسم» with her initial bubble and the dashes under it, the drawer's «ارسم: قطة» in the accent; sideways (667x375) put the toolbox in a column beside the canvas instead of under it so the canvas keeps the height.

title: ردّ على التخمين الغلط
line: A wrong guess gets a short shake on the field and the field clears (today nothing tells the guesser it was read); a right one flies its name to the board (flyEmoji) before the stamp.

title: لفّة كمان
line: For 3-4 players a lobby switch to go round the table twice (steps up to 6, players meet their own chain again near the end) - the small family still gets a chain long enough to drift wildly. Today TELE_MAX_STEPS is capped by the player count.

title: كل واحد يكشف سلسلته
line: In the reveal the chain's owner drives it from their own phone (the next/back buttons move to them, the host can still take over) and the TV says «سلسلة سارة» - each person gets the stage and tells their chain's story.

title: ابعت السلسلة
line: At the end every chain can be sent as one picture (the 📸 share card): the first word, the drawings as small frames and the last sentence, with the app's mark - the family WhatsApp group gets the cat that became a bus.

title: من ... لـ ...
line: After each chain's last step the first word and the last sentence fly to each other on the TV (a ghost flight, as flyConnectGroup) and land side by side under «بدأت بـ / وصلت لـ» before the next chain - the punchline gets its own beat.

title: «دي بتاعتي!»
line: During the reveal the phone whose drawing or sentence is on the TV lights up with «دي بتاعتك» and a buzz, so the author can explain or defend it - the table knows whose step it is without reading small names.

title: شريط الخطوات
line: During play show «خطوة 3/5 · ✏️ ارسم» as dots (ltrFrac, the quizRoundDots look) at the top of every phone and the TV, so a player knows how much is left and whether the next step is drawing or writing.

title: انتظار فيه حاجة
line: After «إرسال» the phone shows only a subtitle (JS_RoomTelephone.html:158); show who is still working as faces that tick off one by one, and a small preview of what you just sent.

title: الرسمة على التلفزيون كبيرة
line: In the reveal at 1280x720 the drawing should take the stage height with the author's name as a caption and the previous step small beside it, rather than step and drawing competing in one column.

title: كارت «إزاي توصف»
line: The describer's first time gets a small card over the chalkboard before «يلا»: three steps (how big, where on the page, what shape) with one example line - read in 5 seconds, and the first round stops being a loss. Help, not a rule.

title: وصّافين ونص صورة
line: A lobby way: two describers, each shown only one half of the picture (top/bottom, or left/right), take turns speaking - they must agree out loud where their halves meet. The drawers still draw one page; the graded % is shared by both describers.

title: سؤال واحد بس
line: A level switch: each drawer gets one yes/no question per round (a ✋ button; the describer's phone shows «سارة عندها سؤال» and they answer aloud) - grandparents and kids get one lifeline without the round turning into a chat.
warn: The owner's spec «talk only: the drawers can't ask questions» (notes/games/hear.md)

title: الكراسة على التلفزيون والناس بتتفرج
line: While the drawers draw, the TV shows the describer's clock and, every 20 seconds, one random page blurred to a silhouette (no detail, never the describer's view) - the room watching gets something to laugh at without giving the drawers anything to copy.
warn: The spec keeps the drawings secret until the reveal (notes/games/hear.md); a blurred shape only

title: صفحتي الأحسن
line: At the podium each phone can send its best page of the night beside the original as a 📸 share card with its % in red pen - the exercise-book look is made for this.

title: الوصّاف بالعرض
line: The describer's chalkboard at 667x375 should fill the screen (picture centred, the clock a thin bar at the edge, «خلّصت» one btn--lg at the side) - sideways is how a describer holds a phone while talking.

title: سلّمت الكراسة بتأكيد
line: «📒 سلّمت الكراسة» is final; make it a hold-to-confirm (press 0.6 s, a ring fills) instead of a single tap, so a palm on the screen doesn't hand in half a drawing.

title: الـ% بتعدّ
line: On the grading screen each page's % counts up (countUp) as the red-pen mark lands, the best last, instead of appearing at once.

title: الكدبة اللي هي الحقيقة
line: Fix: refuse a lie that guessVerdict calls 'right' against the truth (same stem, one letter off, a measure word), not only an exact fold - today «راس» for «راسه» or «168 حرف» for «168» goes on the ballot as a lie.

title: ساعة الكتابة
line: A 60-second writing clock on the server's time (shown as a pencil on the TV); when it ends the vote opens on the lies that are in, like closeWriting does now - the table never waits on one phone and the host doesn't have to be the bad guy.

title: متأكد؟ دبّلها
line: After voting, a voter may tap «متأكد ✌️»: the truth is worth 2000 instead of 1000, but picking a lie then costs 500 - shown as a little ×2 chip on the reveal. The sure ones and the bluffers become visible.

title: مين كاتبها؟
line: Before the owners are shown, the lie that fooled the most is put up alone and everyone guesses who wrote it from the room's players (the people ballot); +250 for a right guess - the family learns who the smooth liar is.

title: السؤال فوق الكيبورد
line: In the writing phase on a 375px phone the keyboard covers the question card; pin a one-line copy of the question above the field while it has focus, with the field's 40-letter count.

title: كذبتك قدامك
line: After sending, show your own lie on the waiting card («كذبتك: …») so you recognise it on the ballot and don't think it was lost.

title: الإجابات شبكة على التلفزيون
line: At 1280x720 the TV's ballot should be a 2-3 column grid of numbered cards in big type instead of one tall list, so the whole room reads every lie at once.

title: الورقة المتأخرة تلحق
line: Fix: after closeWriting, a phone still writing may send its sheet while the turns run, and it is added to the end of the order (RoomTwoTruths.js submit, nextTwoTruthsTurn) - nobody who wrote is ever dropped.

title: مين صاحبها؟
line: A lobby way: the sheets come up without a name; the table votes twice - whose sheet it is, then which line is the lie - a point for each. Cousins who think they know each other find out.

title: صدق ولا كذب على موبايل واحد
line: A one-phone way inside the card: each person writes on the passed phone behind a hold-card, then the phone reads one sheet at a time and the table taps how many hands went up for each line - the lie revealed with the same stamp and podium.

title: أغرب حقيقة
line: After each reveal, a 10-second ✨ tap on whichever true line amazed you; the line with most taps of the night is replayed on the podium with its owner's name - the real stories get their applause.

title: علّم الكذبة بزرار كبير
line: On the writing card mark the lie with a 🤥 toggle on each line (a full-height tap target, the chosen line tinted with the danger soft token) instead of a small radio; Send stays disabled with the reason under it until one is marked.

title: دور مين بيحكي
line: During a turn the top of every phone says «دور خالد يحكي» with his bubble, and the storyteller's own phone shows «الناس بتصوّت عليك… 3/5» instead of an empty spectating note.

title: ختم «كذب» على السطر
line: On the result the lie line gets a red «كذب» stamp (the draw-stamp motion) and the true lines a green tick, with voters' initials stacked on the line they chose.

title: «قرّب» للي كتبها بس
line: Fix: in the room feed a close guess shows its text only on the guesser's phone; others see «🔥 عمر قرّب» - the same leak as ارسم وخمّن, in RoomQuiz.js guess and the feed renderer.

title: تلات محاولات
line: In rooms each player gets 3 tries a card, shown as three hearts under the box; a wrong try costs one - guessing becomes thinking, and spamming stops paying.

title: الفئات في الأوضة
line: The host picks categories in the room lobby, the same chips as the one-phone setup (أفلام مصرية, أفلام كرتون, أكل, أماكن...) - a table of kids plays only cartoons and food.

title: على النار 🔥
line: Solving two cards in a row first gives a 🔥 streak: the next first-solve is worth double, shown as a flame on your name; anyone else solving first puts it out.

title: الإيموجي بتلف
line: A new card's emoji land one after another like a slot machine (spinLetter over a pool of emoji from the bank) on the TV and the one-phone card - a beat of suspense on every riddle, settled at once when motion is off.

title: الإيموجي بالعرض
line: Sideways (667x375) on one phone the card and the bar compete for height; put the bar beside the card and let the emoji take the card's full height.

title: الغلط بيطير
line: In rooms a wrong guess floats up from the field and fades (a small ghost) instead of only appearing in the feed below, so the guesser sees it was judged without looking down.

title: ساعة على حرف الكارت
line: The room card's clock should also be a bar draining along the card's edge (transform scaleX), readable from the sofa on the TV.

title: قرّبت؟ جرّب تاني
line: In rooms a 'close' answer (guessVerdict) is not spent: the player sees «قرّبت!» and gets one more try, worth half the points - a typo no longer loses a saying everyone knows.

title: اختيارات بعد 12 ثانية
line: After 12 seconds three choices appear under the box for anyone who hasn't answered (the real word and two endings from other proverbs), worth fewer points - the kids can still play, as دندنها's choices do after 15 s.

title: المثل يتكتب على اليافطة
line: At the reveal the whole proverb is written across the TV as a shop sign, letter by letter, the missing word dropping in last in another colour, with who got it - the table reads it out together.

title: «ونقول كمان...»
line: After a reveal anyone can tap «عندي مثل زيه» and say a saying with the same meaning aloud; the host taps ✔️ for +3 - the grandparents shine, with no new list to keep.

title: الفراغ بحجم الكلمة
line: Draw the blank as a dashed box the width of the missing word inside the proverb line, not «___», so the eye goes straight to it on a 375px card and on the TV.

title: محاولة واحدة، مكتوبة
line: Since rooms take one answer, the field's placeholder says «محاولة واحدة» and Send confirms with a tick; today a player learns the rule only by losing.

title: مين جاوب صح بالترتيب
line: On the room result list who got it right as chips in order with their points (+15, +14…) counting up, above the board.

title: علّم وهو بيقول
line: During the count the host (or the one phone) taps ✔️ as each thing is said; the third tick ends the turn on the spot with its time («في 3.2 ثانية») and the night's fastest three go on the podium - speed becomes a record to beat.

title: الفئة تلف
line: A way where one category stays for a whole lap: each player in turn must name three new things in it (repeats don't count), until someone fails - out they go, a new category starts, last one standing wins.

title: حط له فئة
line: The previous player chooses the next one's category from three dealt cards on their phone - revenge between cousins, and everyone is involved in every turn.

title: الوقت بيقصر
line: An option where the clock drops each round: 5, then 4, then 3 seconds, shown on the fuse - the last round is chaos and the table can't stop laughing.

title: الخمس ثواني تملا الشاشة
line: When the count starts on the player's phone, the category and a 5-segment ring take the whole screen, other controls hidden - readable at arm's length while talking.

title: زراير الحكم متساوية
line: The verdict pair ✔️ / ✖️ should be two equal btn--lg side by side (success / danger tokens) in the bottom bar, sideways too, with a 3-second undo toast in rooms as the one phone has.

title: مين بعده
line: Between turns show «اللي بعده: منى» under the current player's card, so the next one gets ready.

title: الكسبان يفضل
line: A «ملك التل» way: the side the room chose stays and faces a new option from the next card; at the end the last survivor is crowned «اختيار السهرة» with the chain of what it beat - the same list, a story across rounds.

title: والعائلات التانية؟
line: After the reveal a second line: «٦٢٪ من الناس اختاروا الطيران» - an anonymous tally per question kept by the rooms server (the PromptMemory object already holds per-list memory), never names - the room argues with Egypt, not just itself.

title: الأوضة نصين
line: A TV-only way for no phones: the TV shows the question with a side of the room for each option and a 5-second count; people physically move, the host taps how many stood each side - a living-room game for grandparents.

title: توأم السهرة
line: At the end, the two players who chose alike most often are named «توأم السهرة» and the pair who never agreed «قطط وفيران», with how many times - the bit everyone screenshots.

title: سؤال من عندنا
line: Once a game, a phone can type its own dilemma (two short lines) and it is dealt next with «من عند عمو أحمد» - family in-jokes, kept to the room, never saved to the list.
warn: Content has to stay family-clean (CLAUDE.md, the owner's rules): a typed question is the table's own

title: السؤال قبل الاختيارات
line: The room card shows the round and the game's name but no question line, so the two buttons read as two loose phrases; add «لو خيروك بين…» and an «ولا» divider between the two options.

title: الاختيارين جنب بعض
line: At 667x375 and on the TV lay the two options side by side in their two colours (ballot-option--i0/i1) instead of stacked, and the result bars split the same way.

title: اختيارك بيفضل منوّر
line: After voting, keep your chosen option lit (as the people ballot does) instead of replacing the ballot with a waiting note, so nobody wonders what they tapped.

title: الأصوات اتفرّقت
line: Fix: when the top count is 1 in a room of four or more (scoreMostLikely), nobody scores and the result says «الأصوات اتفرّقت» - today everyone tied on one vote gets a point.

title: تصويت سري
line: A lobby switch that hides the voters' names under the bars (counts only) - families vote honestly when Teta won't see who picked her for «هتتأخر على أي ميعاد».

title: «ظلم!»
line: The one picked can tap «أيوه أنا» (+1 for honesty) or «ظلم!» once a game: the top two go to a 15-second re-vote on the TV between just them - a moment to defend yourself out loud.

title: السائل يختار
line: Each round a different player is the asker: their phone shows three prompts from the list and they pick the one to ask - they aim it at someone, and the room knows it.

title: الاسم كامل على الكارت
line: The people ballot leads with initials in bubbles; with two أحمد or long names at 375px, show the full name on up to two lines with a smaller bubble, and check 12 players fit a 3-column grid.

title: اللي اتختار في النص
line: On the result, put the picked person on a centred card with a big 👉 and the prompt as their title before the bars, rather than only the top bar lit.

title: اقفل التصويت بهدوء
line: «اقفل التصويت» is a btn--lg in the bottom bar beside the count; make it btn--sm secondary until most have voted, so a stray thumb doesn't close the vote early.

title: «مع الجرس»: the last card counts
line: The turn's list ends with the card that was up when time ran out, marked «كان على الشاشة», untagged; one tap scores it if the team shouted it with the bell. Settles the most common argument at the table.

title: The actor picks one of two
line: On the handover card the actor gets two categories flickering (`spinLetter`) and taps one before the 3-2-1; every turn has its own flavour inside one match, and choosing «أفلام» over «أفعال» becomes a little strategy.

title: Long titles are worth two
line: A card of four words or more (most film and play titles) shows a small 2× badge and scores 2 when guessed: the hard classics stop being skipped on sight. Worked out from the card itself, no new list.

title: English proverbs and plays
line: Add a Proverbs category to the English deck from `Proverbs.js` (164 English sayings already checked), so an English table has the same kinds as an Arabic one.

title: «دور الإنقاذ» for the team behind
line: In the relay, the trailing team's last turn gets +15 seconds, announced on its handover card with the gap to close: the match stays open to the end.

title: Play again keeps the old language
line: `startCharades(time)` reuses `appState.charades.currentCategory` on «العب تاني», so after switching Settings → لغة الألعاب the next turn still deals the old language's words; re-take the category from `CHARADES_DB[contentLang()]` when the language changed.

title: Drop the repeated «فيلم» on the card
line: Every film card starts «فيلم …» and wraps to 3-4 lines at 375px in text-5xl («فيلم رمضان مبروك أبو العلمين حمودة»). Show the category as the eyebrow and the title alone, fitted to the width with a clamp so it never passes three lines.

title: Sideways: buttons beside the card
line: At 667×375 the card, the two h-20 buttons and the head stack vertically and the card is a thin strip; put ✅ / تخطي as a column at the inline-end of the card on a phone on its side.

title: A live ✅ count beside the clock
line: The head shows only the timer and ↶ / إنهاء; a small ✅ chip that bumps (`motionBump`) on each right card lets the actor feel the turn going well without looking away for long.

title: The handover card in the team's colour
line: The relay's handover shows the actor's name big on a wash of the team's colour (`--team-red` / `--team-blue`) with the team's score counting up (`countUp`), so whose turn it is reads from across the room.

title: Kinds to pick from
line: The cards already sit in commented groups (animals, jobs, food, places…); give each a kind tag and let the setup pick kinds or «مكس», so a kids' table plays animals and food. No new words.

title: «بالممنوع بس»
line: A twist turn (a setup switch, one turn per round of the relay): the describer may use ONLY the three forbidden words plus gestures. Upside-down and very funny.

title: «سباق الثواني»: each right card +3 s
line: A time-attack way: every ✅ adds three seconds to the clock, so a hot describer can keep a turn alive; the turn's length is the story on the summary («كمّلت 94 ثانية»).

title: «مع الجرس» row on the summary
line: As in بدون كلام: the card on screen at the bell is listed last, untagged, and can be scored with one tap.

title: Forbidden words under each card in the list
line: The turn's fix-it list shows only the word; add its three forbidden words small under it (`tx-muted`), so the table can settle «إنت قلت جناح!» before banking.

title: The forbidden plates as a row sideways
line: `renderDescribeCard` stacks three `plate-danger` blocks; on a phone on its side lay them as three chips in one row beside the word, so the word, the plates and the buttons fit 667×375 without scrolling.

title: A ✅ count in the head
line: `descAction` has the live score commented out; show a ✅ chip beside the timer that bumps on each right card.

title: The new card slides in
line: Charades flips its card on each word, أوصف لي just swaps the text; give the word and its plates the same quick flip (transform only), so the describer notices the change under pressure.

title: The turn's list after the bell
line: After each turn, the same fix-it list as بدون كلام (`partyTurnSummaryHtml`): a ✅ taken back puts its card back in the bowl and its point goes, a ⏭ turned to ✅ scores it.

title: A deck that works three times
line: Deal only cards that can be one-worded and mimed: people, characters, animals, objects; leave out the proverbs and anything over three words (a filter on `TIMESUP_DB`, no new list).

title: Choose the teams
line: «مين مع مين؟»: tap names into two sides (or «وزّع عشوائي» as now) before the start, with the teams kept for «العب تاني». Grandparents get to be on the grandchildren's side.

title: No passing in round one
line: An option the real game has: in round 1 a card can't be skipped (everyone learns the whole deck), passes come back in rounds 2 and 3. Ask the owner whether it is on by default.

title: The rounds' story at the end
line: The finale shows a three-row table per team, each round counting up in turn (`countUp`), then the winner: the team that lost round 1 and won the acting gets its moment.

title: Team pills in team colours
line: The play head shows «فريق 1: 4 | فريق 2: 3» in text-sm with an opacity bar; make two pills on `--team-red` / `--team-blue` with the active team's pill lit and a bump on every point.

title: Tokens, not palette classes
line: The word is `text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300` and the finale cards `bg-blue-500/10` / `bg-amber-500/10`; move them to `tx-accent` and the team tokens, as the design system asks.

title: Skip looks like a button under a clock
line: Here تخطي is `btn--ghost`, while بدون كلام and أوصف لي use `btn--neutral` h-20; give it the same tier and height so a thumb finds it at once.

title: The ready card shows the team and the round's rule big
line: The ready card names the giver; add their team's members under it and the round's rule as a big icon line (🗣️ / ☝️ / 🤐), so the switch to «كلمة واحدة» is never missed.

title: «فكّرني»: look again
line: On one phone, a long press on a player's chip during the questions asks «لفّ الموبايل بعيد عن …» and then shows everyone's character except theirs; the table no longer has to memorise eight names.

title: Whoever got it gives one hint
line: Once you've got yours you hold one «تلميحة»: give a stuck player their category word; if they get it within a minute you earn +1. The early finishers stay in the game.

title: «سؤال مفتوح» once each
line: Each player may ask one open question in the game («بشتغل إيه؟», «عايش فين؟») instead of yes/no, marked on their chip when used; a turning point the table watches for.

title: A room clock
line: The one-phone clock (3, 5, 8 minutes or none) for rooms too, as a server deadline that reveals by itself.

title: Small categories deal twice, not refuse
line: A room start throws «الكلمات أقل من عدد اللاعبين» when the category is smaller than the table (the one phone repeats instead); deal repeats or top up from the mix.

title: Reveal by holding
line: «وريهم شخصيته» shows the character on a tap; use `.hold-card` (shown only while held, `holdCardReset`) as the spy games do, so the hidden player can't catch it.

title: Chips first, clock small
line: The play screen leads with a huge clock in a card (metric--xl, py-10) and the got-it chips below; sideways the chips fall off the screen. Put the clock in the head and the chips where the thumb is.

title: The result flips row by row
line: The final list shows every character at once; turn the rows over one by one (`afterReveal`), unguessed ones last, so each «ده أنا؟!» gets its laugh.

title: A clear band after «عرفت»
line: In rooms, after the press show a band «اتحسبتلك 3 · غلطت؟ لسه» with the undo inside it, instead of only a changed button.

title: An exact guess judges itself
line: In rooms, when `normaliseClue(guess)` equals the word the round is right at once, with the reveal; the host only judges near misses.

title: The writers' check in rooms
line: Before the guesser sees the clues, the writers see them all for 15 s and tap «قريبة قوي» on any too close; two taps strike it. The one-phone check, made for phones.

title: «فوّت» or risk it
line: The guesser may pass (the card is lost); a wrong guess also burns the next card, as in the boxed game, so guessing is a choice. A rule for the owner.
warn: Changes the scoring in notes/games/one-phone-party.md (rounds 5/10/13, one point a word).

title: Emoji clues for kids
line: A way where each clue is one emoji from a keypad: no spelling for the little ones, and duplicates are exact.

title: Close the joined-word loophole
line: «كلمة واحدة بس» only refuses a space: «كرة-قدم» or «كرة_قدم» pass on both the phone (`joSubmitClue`) and the server (`submitClue`); refuse - and _ too.

title: Hide the word until held
line: On one phone the secret word shows as soon as the writer taps; a `.hold-card` keeps it from the guesser's glance, and on a phone on its side the word goes into the field's label so the keyboard doesn't hide it.

title: The final score with the words
line: The final screen is only «7 / 10»; add the rounds' words with ✅ / ❌ and the guesser, flipping in one by one, so the table relives the misses.

title: Who matched, on the TV
line: The TV's guessing frame says only «اتشالت (2)»; show the struck cards face down with the two writers' names on them, so the table sees who thought alike.

title: «أحسن شارح»
line: After each turn the guesser taps the one who helped most (one tap, skippable) for +1: everyone at the table has a reason to shout.

title: The house record
line: The best turn per deck is kept on the phone and shown on the ready card («الرقم: 14 · أحمد»); beating it flies a 🏆 (`flyEmoji`) with «رقم جديد!».

title: Sudden-death tie-break
line: If the top is tied after the rounds, each tied player gets one 30-second turn from the same deck; the podium waits for it.

title: A teens' deck
line: «أنمي وألعاب» from Who Am I's anime and video-game lists, already in the app, for the cousins who find the mix too easy.

title: Two columns on the summary
line: The after-turn list is one long column of toggles; at 375px with 20 words, lay ✅ and ⏭ as two columns with counts and move a word across with `flipGrid`.

title: Instructions once a game
line: After the first turn, fold the three steps on the ready card into one line and leave the name and «جاهز!» big.

title: Long words fit the forehead
line: Film titles from the charades lists wrap to three or four lines on a phone on its side; fit the word to the width with a clamp, at most two lines.

title: The chain ignores «ال»
line: In chain mode the required letter and a name's first letter skip a leading ال, as the table would say it (الهند starts with ه).

title: «مفيش» is checked
line: In chain and names modes, «مفيش عندي» checks the list: if no unused name fits, there's no quarter, «فعلاً مفيش!» and a new chain starts.

title: Names of people
line: A «أسماء» category (boys' and girls' names) from the Stop dictionary's `names` lists, the oldest way to play ربع قرد.

title: «من الناحيتين»
line: A harder letters way: each player adds a letter at the start or the end, so the word grows both ways and the check is «is it inside a name».

title: «كذّاب دبل»
line: The caller may double: two quarters on the line either way. A bold call and a laugh.

title: The verdict band leaves
line: On a phone on its side the keypad, the strip and the verdict compete for 375px; let the verdict band slide away after a few seconds, with a tap bringing it back.

title: The word as tiles with who added each
line: Above the keypad, show the letters as tiles with a tiny initial of who added each, the last one lifted: who to call «كذّاب» on is plain.

title: The required letter biggest
line: In chain mode the letter to start with is the one thing that matters: make it the largest thing on the phone and the TV, with the last name small under it.

title: One phone's fuse can't be timed
line: Use the room's `bombHeatSteps` jitter on one phone too, kept in `appState.bomb` so a reload stays consistent.

title: «سلسلة»
line: A way where each word must start with the last letter of the word before; the table judges and the send-back is the protest.

title: «كارت هروب»
line: Each player once a game may pass without a word (a 🃏 on their chip, then grey).

title: Awards from the passes
line: The server stamps every pass: at the end «أسرع إيد» and «أعصاب حديد» beside the podium.

title: The boom's replay on the TV
line: After the boom the TV replays the round's passes as fast arcs, slowing on the last one, as the room laughs.

title: More categories from الحرباء
line: Deal from the Chameleon categories as well, as زي الكل already does (`herdPrompts`).

title: «بعدك إنت!»
line: The next phone shows a band and a light buzz.

title: The send-back's time on the button
line: A ring that shrinks over the 14 s window.

title: Letter or category, plain
line: A chip «حرف» / «فئة» above the prompt, so a single letter is not misread.

title: Undo the last merge only
line: A merge stack: ↶ undoes one merge instead of recomputing all groups.

title: Merge suggestions
line: Groups where one answer contains the other («بيبسي» / «بيبسي كولا») get a dashed link the host accepts with one tap.

title: «اختار يا خروف»
line: The sheep holder picks the next question from three.

title: Would You Rather rounds
line: Rounds from the لو خيروك list: pick A or B in secret; the majority scores and a lone pick takes the sheep.

title: «جولة أرقام»
line: Now and then, «write a number from 1 to 10» or one letter of the alphabet, generated without a list.

title: «القطيع كله»
line: When everyone writes the same, +2 each and the sheep goes free.

title: Your answer, editable
line: After sending, show «إجابتك: … · غيّرها» until the reveal (submit already overwrites).

title: The merge mode says what to do
line: A band «اختار المجموعة اللي تتضم ليها · إلغاء» while one group is picked, and «المضيف بيجمع الإجابات» on the other phones.

title: The sheep on its holder's phone
line: «الخروف معاك» in the header.

title: الأخير يختار الفئة
line: From question 3, the player last on the board picks the next question's category from three spun tiles (spinLetter over the six categories) on their phone and the TV - a comeback the table sees, and a reason for «يا رب جغرافيا!».

title: وقت السؤال
line: A lobby choice of 10 / 15 / 25 seconds (TRIVIA_SECONDS is fixed today), remembered with the category; 25 for a table with grandparents or kids who read slowly, 10 for the sharks.

title: اقرا السؤال بصوت عالي
line: A switch that reads each question and its four choices aloud with the browser's own speechSynthesis (free, Arabic voice on iPhone) on the TV, or the host's phone without one - kids who can't read yet play with the grown-ups. The same voice serves the buzzer's family quiz.

title: دوري المعرفة: تلات فرق
line: The board for three teams (three households at a gathering): the turn goes round, the steal goes to the next team in turn, the scores row and the steal band in three colours.
warn: Touches the steal as decided (24 Sep 2026: the other team gets one try) - with three, who steals is the owner's call.

title: الدقيقة الأخيرة
line: A lobby switch: the last three questions are a lightning round - 7 seconds each, the speed bonus doubled, a red band and a faster tick on the TV - so the podium can still move at the end.

title: متأكد؟
line: After tapping an answer you have two seconds to tap «متأكد ✋»: right is ×2 points, wrong costs 5. Bold uncles get punished, careful aunts rewarded; the TV shows who bet as hands at the reveal.

title: أ ب ج د مش A B C D
line: The room's answer buttons and results hard-code Latin «A B C D» (JS_RoomTrivia.html triviaFrame, letters = ['A','B','C','D']) even in Arabic, while the team board and the quiz use qm_letters «أبجد». Read the letters from qm_letters so an Arabic screen has no English letters.

title: وانت مستني: مين جاوب
line: After answering, the phone shows only «🔒» and a count «3/5 جاوبوا». Show the faces of who has answered (roomPersonChip, popping in as each arrives, never their choice) and your own pick big, so the wait reads as a race, not a frozen screen.

title: شريط النتيجة بـ scaleX
line: The results' bars are sized by an inline width:%  (.result-row__bar), which the design system says not to animate; draw them full width and grow them with transform: scaleX from the inline-start edge as renderVoteResults does, so the reveal is smooth on old phones.

title: السؤال الطويل على الموبايل وهو نايم
line: At 667x375 the question card, four stacked choices and the strip don't fit, so the last choice is under the fold mid-clock. Sideways, put the question on the start side and the choices as a 2x2 grid on the other, the clock badge beside the question.

title: استعجلت!
line: A host switch: a press while the buzzers are locked (the host still reading) locks that phone for one second, its button greyed with «استعجلت! ⏳»; today such a press is silently ignored, so mashing is free.

title: عدّل النقط بإيدك
line: RoomBuzzer.js has an `adjust { id, delta }` action, but no button sends it (JS_RoomBuzzer.html). Give the host − / + on each standings row (phone and TV host) so an argument an hour ago can still be put right.

title: وش لوش
line: The host taps two names: only those two buzzers are live, the others watch; the TV splits into two halves with their faces. Settles a tie at the top, or a family grudge.

title: ساعة الجواب
line: Once someone is first in line, a 5-second ring drains round their face on the TV and on their phone; it only shows the time, the host still judges (nothing automatic), but the table can shout «الوقت!».

title: لون الجرس
line: Each phone's bell takes the player's colour (the one their chip has), and the TV floods with that colour for half a second on the first press - from across the room you see who buzzed before reading the name.

title: اضغط ساعة ما تلمس
line: The bell fires on onclick, which on touch comes when the finger lifts (the app's tap handling), so a firm long press loses to a light tap and the stamp is ~100 ms late. Stamp and send on pointerdown (pressBuzzer), ignore the click that follows.
warn: Touches the fair-press rule of 1 Oct 2026 (press time on the phone) - it makes it fairer, not different.

title: الجرس قد الشاشة
line: On a phone sideways (667x375) the bell, the order chips and the strip compete; while armed make the bell fill the free height and any tap on the empty area around it buzz too, with the order collapsed to one line.

title: الحالة في كلمة
line: A player's screen shows the same bell whether the host is reading (locked), you're out for this question, or it's live. Give each a clear one-line state over the bell - «🔒 استنى السؤال» / «❌ خرجت من السؤال ده» / «🔔 دلوقتي!» - with the bell's colour following.

title: على موبايل واحد
line: A pass-the-phone way inside the card: the phone shows the player up their hand (cards are face up in the real game, only years hidden) and the line, the year revealed after the tap. The deck comes from the rooms server per deal so the bank still isn't shipped in the page.
warn: TimelineEvents.js is server-only by decision (the answer key must not ship) - a one-phone deal fetched from the server keeps that.

title: ساعة الدور
line: A lobby choice: off / 30 / 60 seconds a turn on the server's clock, the ring on the player's chip; time out and the card picked (or a random one) goes into the gap nearest the middle.

title: الورقة بتطير لمكانها
line: A right card flies from the hand into its gap and the line opens to make room (a ghost + Web Animation, as flyConnectGroup); a wrong one flies to where it really belongs, flashes its year and drops off the line.

title: الغلط يفضل باهت
line: A wrong card stays on the line at its true place, greyed with its year - the line grows faster and the table learns, so later turns get both easier and tighter.
warn: Changes the rule as built (a wrong card is out) - the owner's call.

title: لاعبين من الكمبيوتر
line: Computer players (ROOM_BOT_GAMES) that know a year with an error that grows with how far back it is, so a bot gets 2010 right and the Ottomans wrong - two people get a full table.

title: الخط بيروح لمكانك
line: On the phone the line (.tl-line, overflow-x) never moves by itself: after each placement scroll it to the new card and pulse it, and when you pick a card show a small ◀ ▶ hint with how many gaps are off screen.

title: الخط عمودي على الموبايل
line: At 375 wide, while it is your turn, show the line as a vertical list (earliest on top, a + between every two rows) instead of a sideways strip - every gap a full-width 48px tap, no sideways hunting.

title: التلفزيون يشوف اللي في إيدك
line: The TV shows the player up's hand (the event texts, never the years) and highlights the one they picked, so the room can argue «قبل التلفزيون أكيد!». The TV's game over also lacks the podium the phone draws (TV_GAMES.timeline gameover): add renderPodium there.
warn: The hand slice is a secret slice today; the leak probes must allow the texts (never the years).

title: خط الأرقام
line: The TV (and the phone's pile) draws a ruler 1-100 where each played card drops onto its spot; the empty stretch above the last card is the tension everyone feels, now seen. A missed card lands in red behind it.

title: النبض
line: A switch for kids' tables: every phone pulses softly (a light vibration and a dot) on one shared beat from the server's clock, so the table can count silently together - an easier way, our own twist on keeping time.

title: كانت مع مين؟
line: The lost-heart card shows each missed card with its holder («23 كانت مع سارة») in a kind tone, so the table learns who plays slow; today shared.lost has the numbers only (RoomMind.js mindAction 'play').
warn: Never a mean title - the wording is about learning, not blame.

title: ✋ استنوا
line: Mid-level any phone can raise a hand: a ✋ pops over their face on the TV and every phone for 3 seconds, once a level each - the silent «wait for me» a real table does with its eyes.

title: تلميح المدى
line: Once a game the table can ask for one hint: a random phone's lowest card is shown as a range («بين 40 و 60») on the TV - spent wisely it saves a heart.

title: اضغط واسحب عشان تنزل
line: The single «play» button costs a heart on a mis-tap. Make it press-and-hold (0.4 s, a ring filling round it, like the hold-card) or a short slide up, so a pocket or a nudge never plays a card.

title: رقمك على قد الشاشة
line: On a phone sideways your lowest number and its button should be the big thing on the start side and the pile, hearts and counts on the other; today they stack and the button can sit under the fold at 667x375.

title: المستوى خلص: الجاية فيها كام
line: The level-done card says the next level but not what it means; show «المستوى 4: كل واحد ٤ ورقات» with the hearts left as icons, and the host's «يلا» button labelled with it, so nobody asks.

title: لوحدك في الخانة = ٢٠
line: The paper game's own rule: if you are the only one with a valid answer in a category (everyone else blank or wrong), it scores 20 - hard categories finally pay.
warn: The scoring 10 / 5 / 0 as built in notes/games/stop.md - the owner's call.

title: وقف غلط
line: A stopper whose sheet has a word the host leaves at 0 (❓ unknown, or wrong) loses 10 on the round, shown as «وقف غلط» with a puncture on the bus. Today stopAnswerFits (StopWords.js) accepts any two letters on the letter, so nonsense stops the round for free.

title: خانات جديدة
line: Two categories from lists the app already keeps: «مواصلات» and «آلة موسيقية» from SPY_WORDS (transport, instruments), checked by stopLettersFor so a round still only deals answerable letters.

title: جولة آخر حرف
line: Once a game (a lobby switch) the bus arrives backwards: words must END with the letter. The same dictionary checks the word; the fit rule looks at the last letter after the fold.

title: الركاب بيتملوا
line: In rooms each passenger's head in the bus window fills like a gauge as their boxes turn green (only the count, never the words), so the table feels who is close to وقف.

title: الحرف والساعة لازقين فوق
line: On a phone, once a box has the focus, collapse the bus to a slim sticky row - the letter, the clock, «باقي N خانات» - so the keyboard leaves the boxes visible; the bus comes back when the keyboard closes.

title: Enter يروح للخانة الجاية
line: Make Enter (the keyboard's «التالي») jump to the next empty box and, on the last, focus وقف - fewer taps with one thumb; give each field enterkeyhint=next.

title: جدول المراجعة على الموبايل
line: The review table is wide (names pinned at one edge, «المجموع» at the other) and at 375 the categories scroll in between; offer a per-player card view (one card per person, their words and points) with a toggle, and keep the ❓ cells first for the host.

title: الظرف التلاتة
line: The hummer gets three sealed envelopes (three songs, titles shown only to them) and picks the one they know; the other two go back to the deck. No more «معرفهاش» rounds.

title: دويتو
line: Every other round two hummers hear the same song and hum alternate lines (the app tells them who starts); both get the hummer's 2 - shy people hum with a partner.

title: قايمة أغاني السهرة
line: At the end, the share card lists the night's songs with their singers, and each gets a ▶ to hear it again on the phones - the night's playlist to send to the family group.

title: أحلى أغنية الليلة
line: At the end every phone taps the one song it enjoyed most; the winner is crowned with its clip played once on the host's phone and kept on الشلة's night as «أغنية السهرة».

title: بتطول لدندنة
line: Bring «بتطول»'s growing bonus to «دندنة»: a right name in the first 5 s of humming is +1 for both the guesser and the hummer - rewards a clear hum, not only a fast guess.

title: اللافتة فوق الكيبورد
line: When the sign field has the focus on a phone, fold the crowd and the front row to one line of faces so the bulbs (the clock) and your sign stay above the keyboard; today the hall keeps its full height.

title: اضغط واسمع: قولها بوضوح
line: The hummer's «press and hold» envelope is learned by trying; on the first song of a game show a one-line coach under it («دوس مطوّل على الظرف عشان تشوف الأغنية، والسماعة على ودنك») and a 🎧 icon pulsing until it is opened.

title: الموبايل نايم: المسرح جنب الكتابة
line: At 667x375 put the stage and bulbs on the start side and the crowd + sign / four choice signs on the other, instead of one tall column that scrolls during a 15-second window.

title: كل واحد يسأل
line: A room way: in the lobby every phone writes two questions about themselves (four choices), then the room plays them all mixed, «سؤال من: خالو» on the card, the writer can't answer their own and scores when others get it right. Everyone contributes, nothing to prepare.

title: اقترحلي إجابات غلط
line: In the editor, a 🪄 under the answers fills the three wrong choices from the app's big lists of the same kind as the right one (a country → MONKEY_LISTS countries, an animal → SPY_WORDS animals, a number → nearby numbers); one tap swaps any of them.

title: أقسام المسابقة
line: The author can add a section heading between questions («أسئلة عن جدو», «أفلام»); the team board uses them as its column names and the room shows the section as an eyebrow - a family quiz that feels like a real show.

title: أصعب سؤال
line: The pack counts, per question, how many got it right in rooms (numbers only, no names, kept in PackStore); the author's list shows «٢ من ٩ عرفوه» on each row - the next quiz gets better.

title: جرّبها لوحدك
line: «▶ جرّب» on the author's own quiz plays it through solo like سلسلة الإجابات (no score kept), to catch a wrong tick before the family sees it.

title: صح ولا غلط
line: A question type with two answers (صح / غلط) for quick writing; the room and the board show two big buttons. packCleanQuiz would accept 2 or 4 choices.

title: الإجابات تحت بعض على الموبايل
line: The open question's four answers are a 2x2 grid (.qopen__grid, 1fr 1fr) - at 375 each field is ~150px beside its ✓, too narrow for 60 characters. Below 420px make it one column, the ✓ on the start side of each row.

title: عدّاد اللي فاضل
line: The title card says how many questions; add a slim progress «١٢ جاهزين · ٢ ناقصين ⚠️» and make «⚠️ ناقص» rows tappable from it, so the author goes straight to what blocks «احفظ» instead of finding out on save.

title: أول مرة: مثال جاهز
line: An empty quiz list is a blank «＋ مسابقة جديدة». Offer «شوف مثال» that opens a three-question sample (about the app's own games) to read and copy, so a first-timer sees what a good question and its wrong answers look like.

title: عدّل البرنامج وانت ماشي
line: Between games the host's ⚙️ opens the builder on what's left: add, remove or reorder the coming games without ending the program (programEdit, host only, between only).

title: فقرة الاستراحة
line: A «☕ استراحة» tile in the line-up (5 / 10 / 15 min): the TV shows the table so far, a big soft countdown and the next game's poster, the phones a «كمّلوا لما ترجعوا» button for the host.

title: الجاية بالتصويت
line: A slot where the host puts 2-3 games and the room votes on the between card (renderVoteResults, 8 s); the host still chose the candidates.
warn: The owner decided the host picks every game (no suggestions) - the host picks the candidates, the table picks among them.

title: الفقرة الأخيرة دبل
line: A switch: the last game of the program places 10 / 6 / 4 / 2, announced with a gold band on the between card - the night isn't decided by game three.
warn: The night's points are one rule everywhere (NIGHT_PLACES 5/3/2/1, 30 Sep 2026) - this would make the program's table differ from the room's night and الشلة.

title: السهرة بالأرقام
line: Before the champion, the finale counts up the night (countUp): «٥ ألعاب · ساعة و٢٠ دقيقة · ٤٧ سؤال · ١٢ ضحكة على الجرس»… from what the program already logs.

title: الوقت والعدد في الشيت
line: In the builder, each row shows its game's minutes (GAME_LIST mins) and the total at the top «حوالي ساعة ونص», and a game whose room.min is more than the people in the room gets an amber «محتاجة ٣» before the host starts.

title: الشيت التلات خانات على الموبايل
line: The builder is one centred sheet with three panes (list, picker, options); at 667x375 the picker's posters and the sticky buttons leave a sliver to scroll. Sideways and under 700px tall, open the picker full-screen with a clear «✓ تمام (٤)» and come back to the list.
warn: Popups are centred dialogs (the owner's rule) - a full-height dialog, not a page.

title: شريط البرنامج وانت بتلعب
line: Nothing shows the program during a game (on purpose, the pill covered العقل's hearts). Add a tiny «🌙 ٢ من ٥» in the room's header row of every game (not floating), so people know how much of the night is left.

title: السهرة الجاية
line: The manager sets the next night's date and time on the crew page; each member taps «جاي 🙋 / مش هقدر», the card shows faces of who's coming and a countdown, and the room for the crew opens from it.

title: تاج البطل
line: The reigning month's champion wears a 👑 on their chip in every room opened for the crew (lobby, strip, TV) - and if someone beats them that night, the TV says «التاج اتنقل!».

title: وحشتنا
line: A member missing for a month gets «وحشتنا يا …» on the page with a one-tap WhatsApp invite to the next night - warm, never a ranking of absence.
warn: Never a mean title (crew decision).

title: تحدي الشهر
line: A shared goal for the whole crew each month («كلنا نكسب لعبة واحدة على الأقل», «نلعب ٨ ألعاب مختلفة») shown as a bar; reached, the wall gets a star for the month. Co-op, so the youngest counts as much as the champion.

title: عيد ميلاد الشلة
line: On the crew's creation date a banner and «سنة في أرقام»: nights, games, the most played game, the record holders - a reason to meet that day.

title: شلة جديدة: أول سهرة
line: A crew with no nights shows an empty podium and empty tabs; replace it with one clear card «أول سهرة؟» → «افتح غرفة للشلة» (primary) and «ادعي الباقيين» with the QR, and hide the empty tabs until the first night.

title: ليه هو الأول؟
line: The month's table ranks by nights won, then points, with no word of it; put a small legend under the table («الترتيب: السهرات اللي كسبتها، وبعدين النقط») and show the tie-breaker on hover / tap of a row.

title: إنت مين فيهم: صور مش أسامي
line: «إنت مين فيهم؟» lists names as chips; with 20+ members on a 375 phone it's a wall of text. Show faces (the cast avatar each member already gets) in a grid with the name under, the phone's saved name ringed first, and a search box from 12 members.

title: مفاجأة كل مكان
line: Each place gets its own surprise next to the generic ones: a sandstorm covering half the microbus panel (swipe it clear), steam fogging the kitchen panel (rub it), a power cut on the wedding panel (dark, a control lights only under the finger). Same rules, the place finally feels different.

title: «المنادي» للي بيتفرج
line: A watcher's phone shows every open order (the public shared.orders, never the panels) with its draining bar, so a latecomer or a ninth person becomes the table's caller who reads out the order about to burn - they play without holding a panel.

title: ابدأ من مستوى
line: The host can start at any level up to the room's best (a stepper in the lobby, default 1), so a table that already knows the panels skips the easy levels on play again; the best still counts levels cleared.

title: الطلب المستعجل
line: From level 3, now and then one order is gold: half the time, but worth +2 progress, with a different alarm on the TV - the table drops everything to shout that one.

title: نهاية الحكاية
line: When a game ends, the TV plays the place's ending scaled to the levels cleared: the microbus stops short of the oasis or rolls into it, the guests eat or leave hungry, the bride's entrance under lit lanterns or in the dark - with the levels counting up over it.

title: الاحتياطي بيدخل
line: A latecomer joins at the next level's card instead of the next game (panels are dealt again every level with surprises on), up to 8 at the table - nobody sits out a long good run.
warn: Decision in notes/games/wire.md: a latecomer watches and is dealt in by play again

title: Watcher screen: more than one line
line: games/wire/JS_RoomWire.html wrPhoneHtml: a phone not at the table gets only .wr-watch («بتتفرج») under the bars; show the place's scene in small (the road, the fridge, the stage) so the watcher sees the game, not an empty card.

title: Your order vs. someone else's
line: On the order panel, mark at once whether the control is on your own panel (a green «عندك ↓» chip that points at it) or not («زعّق!»), instead of only the general hint wr_shout - the second it saves is the game at level 6.

title: Sideways and TV-less phones
line: At 667x375 put the order and the two bars in a column beside the panel so all controls stay above the fold; on a phone without a TV, pulse the damage bar's edge in --danger at one damage from the end, matching the beep the host's phone plays.

title: «ليه كده؟» بعد الغلطة
line: On a mistake and at a lost safe, the result card shows the rule that applied and the right answer («فيه سلكين أحمر: كان لازم تقطع التاني»), on the opener's phone and the TV - a table learns to read grandpa instead of guessing.

title: قفل الحروف
line: A fifth lock: letter wheels on the chest and a page of words in grandpa's handwriting; the opener reads out the letters each wheel can show, the readers find the one word that fits - words drawn from the Wordle bank already in the app.

title: نفخة على الشمعة
line: In «فريقين», the first team to open a lock blows a gust at the other side's candle: it burns double for 8 s with a flicker on their phones and the TV - the race finally touches the other team.

title: المفتاح الاحتياطي
line: Every third safe opened clean (no mistake) earns a brass key hung on the TV's washing line; spending it opens any one lock of a later safe outright - a reason to play clean, not only fast.

title: المفتوح على الرف
line: Endless's end: each opened chest drops onto an attic shelf one by one with its level, the count rising (countUp), the room's best marked with a ribbon - the run as a picture instead of a single number.

title: Fix: the watcher's line
line: games/vault/vault.text.js vt_watching says «تلعب في الجولة الجاية» / «you play next round», but a latecomer is only dealt in by play again: say the next game.

title: Reader with several pages: page tabs
line: When a reader holds two or more pages, put a sticky row of lock icons (wires / symbols / dial / lights) at the top of the notebook that jumps to each page, instead of scrolling a long notebook on a 375px phone while the opener talks.

title: Chest number on every reader page
line: In «واحد بيفتح» the reader is told to ask for the chest's number; add an empty «رقم الصندوق: _ _ _ _» box on the dial page the reader can type into, so the twist rule is read against what the opener said, not memory.

title: The cut is armed: say it
line: The two-tap wire cut shows ✂ on the armed wire; also lift the wire and show a «اضغط تاني للقطع» line under the stage for a second, so a first-time opener doesn't think the first tap did nothing.

title: «الميكروفون»
line: A lobby switch: one guide at a time holds the mic (shown big on every phone and the TV); only they may talk, and a tap passes it to the next guide or the one the mover calls - a loud table becomes a game of who explains best.

title: حكاية تالتة: سطح العمارة
line: A third story drawn the same way: laundry lines, the water tank, satellite dishes, the pigeon coop; pigeons that flap across as moving traps and a sleeping bawab on the stairs - the goal the kite stuck on the antenna.

title: البطارية
line: A way to play: the torch has a battery of steps per level (the map's shortest walk plus a margin) instead of only hearts; every bump costs extra - guides count steps out loud.

title: دايخ!
line: From level 3, a bump into the cat or a pillar makes the mover dizzy for 5 s: their left and right arrows swap, and only the guides are told («منى دايخة: الشمال يمين!») - they must say it the other way round.

title: عين الماشي على التلفزيون
line: A picture-in-picture on the 3D TV: what the mover would see by the torch's small circle, from their height, beside the top view - the room watches the mover feel along the wall (the mover's back is to the TV anyway).

title: Mover's screen: show the last direction
line: games/dark JS_RoomDark.html dkDrawMover: after each step, draw a fading arrow of the step taken and a short «⟵ اتحركت شمال» line, so when guides ask «روحت فين؟» the mover can answer without remembering.

title: Lens chips that name the guide
line: The dashed rings of other guides are only colours; put the guide's initial on each ring and a legend chip row under the map, so «أنا عند المطبخ» can be matched to a ring at 375px.

title: Bigger arrows sideways
line: At 667x375 the arrows (steps mode) should take the full height beside the sonar at 64px or more, in a cross layout with the keyboard's arrows shown as hints on a laptop; a missed tap in the dark is a lost step.

title: رتّبوا نفسكم
line: Before the first order, each phone taps «أنا بعد …» (or the host drags names) to set the real order round the table; the drawn seats, «in turn» and the pulse follow it - the turn finally goes where the eyes go.

title: طبّل معايا
line: A new order from level 4: the TV (or the host's phone) plays a short darbuka pattern, then everyone taps it back together; each tap is judged against the beats by its server stamp - a hand off the beat is named.

title: الإيد الدهب
line: A hand that is right five orders in a row gets a gold ring drawn on its cartoon hand on the table (lost on a mistake); the night's clean hands count it as +1 - a streak to protect.

title: سفرتنا
line: At the end, the earned dishes slide into a picture of the full table with the count of each (3 فول, 2 كنافة…) and the level reached, shareable on WhatsApp through the share card.

title: إيد على إيد
line: An order from level 5: pairs dealt on screens («إنت ومنى») must press within 0.2 s of each other, without saying who they are - the table watches eyes meet.

title: The order card: one big word
line: The order card holds the order and a sub line; on a 375px phone make its key word big (the N, «محدش», «مع بعض») and the rest small, so the 2.6 s read lands - long orders like the secret sum are read late today.

title: The pad says what you did
line: After lifting, the pad keeps a small count of your own taps («دوست 3») until the verdict, so in «tap N times» a player knows their own count without waiting for the reveal.

title: Seats past eight
line: With 10-12 people the far and near rows of hands crowd at 375px and the name plates clip; switch to initials on the plates and a two-row near edge from nine players, with the full name only on your own seat.

title: رسامين بيتسابقوا
line: From 6 players two artists build from the same description; both sketches go up, the match % decides who drew closer (+1), and the jury gets two pictures to help them - more people drawing, more laughs at the reveal.

title: ممنوع تقول…
line: Some rounds deal the witness a taboo card shown only to them and the TV: «ممنوع ألوان», «ممنوع تقول نضارة», «اوصف بتشبيهات بس» - the jury laughs at the workaround.

title: كل جولة أصعب
line: The look gets shorter as the game goes on (8 s, then 6, then 5) and the look-alikes closer - the last witnesses face the hard case; the case count on the TV says it.
warn: Owner's spec: 8 seconds, 6 faces in the lineup

title: أول واحد صح
line: The first juror to lock the right suspect gets +1 extra, shown as a gold coin among the initialled ones - a reason to commit early instead of waiting for the others.

title: شاهد زور
line: A switch: one round in the game the witness is secretly told to get one feature wrong on purpose; if the jury still convicts the real face the jury wins, if they pick the decoy the witness scores - the room hunts the lie at the reveal.

title: Builder: what changed
line: In witBuilderHtml, mark each category tab with a dot once the artist touched it and show the tab's current pick as a tiny label («شعر: كيرلي»), so the artist knows which features are still the plain-man default.

title: Mugshot beside the builder on a phone
line: Upright at 375px the mugshot scrolls away when the builder's options are long; keep a small sticky mugshot thumbnail at the top of the builder so each pick is seen land.

title: Jury's wait screen
line: While the artist draws, a juror sees the sketch growing; add the clock ring and «اسمع الشاهد كويس» with the number of suspects to come, so the jury knows their job is coming and what it is.

title: عرض الحاج
line: Before the lid flies, the studio's old host offers the winner a sum to hand the box back unopened (based on the bids and the boxes left); the winner has 8 s to take the money or open it while the table shouts.

title: الإشاعة
line: Once a game each player may send one anonymous rumour from a short set of true-or-false lines about the box up («سمعت إن فيه عقرب»); it scrolls on the TV with no name - lies stop coming only from people's mouths.
warn: Owner's rule: clues always true; lies come from people only

title: تأمين
line: While bidding, a player can add 50 ج of insurance: if they win a scorpion or are robbed by the thief, they lose half. The insured bids light up with a 🛡️ at the opening.

title: صندوق الختام
line: The eighth box is announced as the finale: everything inside counts double (a double treasure, a double scorpion) with its own drumroll - the last box can turn the podium over.

title: راهن من برّه
line: Who passed (bid 0) taps one prediction before the opening - «حلو» or «وحش» - and gets 30 ج if right: nobody is just watching the box they didn't buy.

title: The bid step: show the stakes
line: On the bid screen, under the big number, show «هيفضل معاك 650» and the richest player's money, so a bid is read against the table without looking at the TV; the +50 / +100 chips at 48px, «كله» apart from them.

title: Clue still in reach after locking
line: Once the bid is locked the phone goes to waiting; keep the clue on a small held card there («دليلك») - people want to argue their clue during the last call, after they bid.

title: Sideways crop
line: At 667x375 the cropped studio and the bid compete for height; during the bid hide the studio crop and show the opened-boxes strip only, bringing the studio back for the opening.

title: وشوش الشلة
line: Each person builds their own cartoon in الشاهد's builder once; the board mixes the room's own faces with generated ones - «هو عمو مجدي؟» becomes the funniest question of the night.

title: علامة استفهام
line: A third state for a face: a long-press marks it «؟» (tilted, a sticker) instead of down, for answers the table argues about; it is your own note and counts as up.

title: البطل بلوحة أكبر
line: A lobby switch: a champion on a streak of 2+ plays on a bigger board (24 → 30) while the challenger keeps the smaller one - winner stays stays fair.

title: أحسن سؤال
line: At the end the TV replays the winner's questions with how many faces each one put down, and crowns «أحسن سؤال» (the one that knocked down the most) - the table learns what a good question is.

title: جريئة!
line: A guess made with many faces still up wins a badge «خمّن و 6 وشوش لسه واقفة!» on the result and the night's board notes the boldest guess of the evening.

title: اخفي اللي وقعوا
line: A toggle on the board («اللي لسه واقفين بس») collapses the faces that are down so the rest grow bigger with no scroll on a 375px phone; tapping it again shows the full board.

title: Whose move, in one line
line: In the bar, show one sentence at the top that changes per stage («دورك تسأل» / «منى بتسأل… استعد» / «وقّع اللي مش هو، وبعدين خلصت»), the same words in teams with the team's name - the stages ask/answer/flip are clear only after a game.

title: Watchers' boards sideways
line: At 667x375 a watcher's phone shows two boards side by side too small to read; show one at a time with a two-tab switch (each player's name) and the faces-down count on the tab.

title: النهائي
line: When two are left the music turns into a zaffa, the TV puts a spotlight on the last chair and both avatars, and the stop is replayed in slow motion with both times - the final feels like a final.

title: كراسي بجد
line: A one-phone way inside the card: the phone or TV plays the climbing maqsum and stops at random for real chairs in the salon; the host taps who is out and the app counts chairs and plays the winner's fanfare.
warn: Owner's spec: rooms and the TV only

title: امسك وارقص
line: A switch: while the music plays everyone must hold a finger on «ارقص» (lifting is a false start); at the stop lift and tap «اقعد!» - no tapping in advance, hands busy the whole song.

title: الكرسي الدهب
line: One chair a round glows gold on the ring; the first to sit takes it and is safe next round too (a crown on the avatar) - a reason to be first, not just not last.

title: الأرقام القياسية
line: The room keeps its fastest sit of the evening across play again (like _wireBest) and slams «رقم جديد للأوضة!» with the name - RoomChairs.js keeps no record today.

title: Out, but still in it
line: A player who is out sees only a waiting note (mch_you_out); give them the ring live at full size with the next stop's suspense and their own place («خرجت سابع»), so the phone stays worth looking at.

title: The 3 seconds, visible
