line: The draining 3-second bar is in the ring's middle; also run it round the edge of the «اقعد!» button itself, where the eyes are, and buzz once at 1 s left.

title: Sideways ring
line: At 667x375 the ring and the big button stack; put the button beside the ring at the thumb's side (the inline-end in Arabic, mirrored in English) so the tap is reachable while watching the ring.

title: اختار عربيتك
line: Each player picks a body before the round: the black-and-white taxi, the tuk-tuk, the microbus, the ice-cream cart - same physics, drawn on the TV in 3D and flat; a family recognises its own car at once.

title: بطولة الملاهي
line: A way: four short rounds - balloons, points, the ring, the ball - with places turned into points across them and a podium at the end; the night's board takes the whole tournament.

title: احمي العريس
line: A team way: one car decorated as the groom's, his side protects him, the others try to knock him three times before the clock - the zaffa horn plays on every save.
warn: Decision: no items (bumping only) - this adds none

title: فرق قوة
line: The last round's winner drives a slightly lighter car (pushed further) and a player marked small a heavier one - nobody sees it, the rounds get closer.

title: Fix: a phone's place without a TV
line: Start is refused with no screen (review of 1 Oct); the greyed lobby only says it; add a «إزاي أوصل التلفزيون؟» link that opens the TV ways note, since bumper is the one game that cannot start without one.

title: The stick you can feel
line: The phone's stick zone has no edge felt by a thumb; buzz lightly when the finger crosses the stick's rim and draw the rim bolder in --accent so a player who looks at the TV stays on it.

title: Big status, small chrome
line: Upright at 375px the balloons, score and place should be one bold row at the top in the car's colour, with turbo and horn as two 64px round buttons under the thumb; the stick/tilt switch moved into a small ⚙ so it isn't hit mid-drive.

title: Which car am I?
line: At the countdown, the TV pulses a ring under each car with the player's name and the phone shows its own colour full-screen for a second - in an 8-car rink the first seconds are spent finding yourself.

title: جولة تجربة
line: The first game in a room starts with a practice round: everyone hides and fires but nobody is out and hearts stay, with a line on each phone saying what happened to them - the table learns the reveal before it counts.

title: البرج
line: A switch: a turret in the middle of the arena whose aim is shown to everyone while hiding; at the reveal it fires along that line too - a danger you can read and use to herd others.

title: عمود مراية
line: A kind of pillar that reflects a beam instead of stopping it (a silver capsule), so a clever shot goes round a corner - with bouncing off, it's the only bounce.

title: الطُعم
line: A new pickup: a hologram of yourself left at a second spot; beams that hit it fizzle it with «ضحكت عليك!» on the TV, and the shooter's ⚡ doesn't count.

title: الحلبة بتتمايل
line: At the reveal the TV tilts the arena into a 3D perspective (CSS transform, no three.js) as the guns charge, and back flat for the hits - the moment of all firing gets depth for free.

title: Fix: standing still is free
line: A player who chose nothing keeps their last spot and aim every round (RoomLaser.js); a phone left on the table can survive several rounds. After two rounds untouched, move them to a random spot and say «مش هنا؟» on the TV.
warn: Owner's rule: a player who chose nothing stays where they were

title: Three steps while hiding
line: Over the arena show a small step row «١ اقف · ٢ صوّب · ٣ جاهز» that ticks as each is done, so with the shield, ⟲ ⟳, the pickup and ready around the arena a new player sees the one thing left to do.

title: Buttons in one thumb row
line: At 375px keep the ⟲ 🛡️ ⟳ row and «استخدمها» in one row of equal .btn--sm buttons under the arena and ready alone as .btn--lg below; at 667x375 put them in a column beside the arena so it keeps its full height.

title: The out phone's job
line: An out player's phone says «خرجت»; with ghosts on, make the mine the screen's one big call to action («حط لغمك 💣») with the arena ready to tap, not a line under the watch view.

title: ركّز!
line: A switch: the screen shows a colour word written in another colour («أحمر» in green) and you tap only when the word and the colour agree - the room laughs at the mind's slip; the fakes rule counts it ✖.

title: جولة بالودن
line: Once a game the green is a sound only: the screen stays dark and the TV (or each phone) plays the bell - a different reflex, and the phones' own stamps keep it fair.

title: خروج المغلوب
line: A way in the room: each round the slowest (or ✖) is out, until two are left for a best-of-three final - the elimination of musical chairs at reaction speed.

title: أربعة على موبايل
line: On a tablet or a big phone flat on the table: four quarters, one per corner, the same rules - a family of four plays on one device.

title: رقم الأوضة
line: The room keeps its fastest time of the evening across play again (room._reactionBest, like the other games' bests) and slams «رقم جديد للأوضة!» with the name - RoomReaction.js keeps none today.

title: خط النهاية
line: The round's result on the TV as a track: each tap a runner that crosses the line at its ms (scaled), the fastest first, ✖ tripping at the start - the rows' data drawn as a race.

title: One-phone halves: whose side
line: The two halves are colour states only; put each player's name (from the picker) on their half upside-down for the far player, so a phone flat between two people says who is who and who won.

title: Room pad: your result stays
line: After the green the pad shows your time and the round's place («تاني 🥈») until the next red, instead of only the rows below the fold at 375px - the reason you tapped is on the pad.

title: «فاكر؟» before the reveal
line: When the round ends and before the hands turn, each phone gets one question about a card it really saw this round («كارت منى التالت كان كام؟»), with four choices; a right answer is a side point and a 🧠 on the seat. It rewards the memory that is the whole game, and the server already knows who looked at what (h.looks).

title: «جولة تجريبية» with the app as teacher
line: A practice round against ghost seats on your own phone: the app deals a scripted hand and walks you through draw, keep, throw a match, a peek, خد وهات and calling سكرو, one card at a time, so a cousin who never played joins the real room ready.

title: The TV replays the big moves
line: After a بوم, a صرخة أوسكار or a كعب داير lands, the TV plays it once more at half speed in a corner while the next player thinks (face down, as the phones' ↺ شوف تاني does), so the sofa can follow what just happened to whose cards.
warn: Memory is the game (only the latest move, face down, never a history)

title: «الكومة بتتكلم» pile peek
line: A long-press on the pile shows the last five cards thrown in order (all of them were face up for everyone), so a player who looked away during a turn can catch up the way a real table glances at the pile; never the cards under that.
warn: Memory is the game: this only shows the shown window SKREW_PILE_SHOWN, never hidden cards

title: Score card: «الجولة دي اتلعبت بإيه؟»
line: On the table score card, a round can be tagged with the version that was played (الحرامي, المسحراتي…) so the history shows which rounds had a thief; the thief's question on the card then only appears on rounds that had it, one fewer tap per round.

title: Fix: the score card's hand fields don't move on
line: JS_Screw.html line ~747: the hand totals are type="number" with no enterkeyhint, so on an iPhone Done closes the keyboard after every player. Add enterkeyhint="next" and move the focus to the next player's field on Enter (the last one to Save), keeping the minus sign for −1 hands.

title: Lobby: fold the options into three rows
line: The host's panel in lobbyOptions is eleven fields in a column (version, add-ons, house rules, basra, teams, rounds, memorise, lap, sudden death, helper, clock). Keep the version tiles open and fold the rest into «القواعد» and «الوقت» lobby-opts rows with their summary line (lobbyOptsSummarise, as السلم والتعبان's «الخريطة والقواعد»), so a 375px phone sees Start without scrolling past nine switches.

title: Bar: say the two steps of a turn
line: On your turn the sticky bar shows a small two-dot step line «١ اسحب أو خد من الأرض ← ٢ احتفظ أو ارمي» with the current step lit, for a player's first two games (kept per phone); the steps are what new players miss, not the buttons.

title: Waiting state at big tables
line: When it is not your turn at 8-12 seats, your own hand in the bottom half is the only thing still: show «دورك بعد ٣» under it with the seats in between as small faces, so a phone that waits knows how long and whose move to watch.

title: «سقف الكومة» stack limit
line: A switch shown only with stacking on: a stack stops at +8 (or +12); the next draw card can't be added and the player facing it takes the whole pile. Keeps the stacking the owner's table loves without one person drawing 20.
warn: Stacking rules are the owner's spec (on by default, +2 on +2, +4 on +4); this is an extra switch, off by default

title: «تقل البطل» handicap across play again
line: A lobby switch: whoever has the most wins tonight at أونو starts the next round with one card more (two at three wins ahead), shown as a 👑 on their seat; the evening stays open instead of one champion running away.

title: «أونو نار» 10-second clock
line: A turn clock of 10 seconds beside 30 and 60, with the bar's ring draining in red; the clock already plays for you, so a fast table gets a frantic party version and nobody waits.

title: The TV as commentator
line: On a big moment the TV shows one short Egyptian line over the table for 2 s, built from the event: «+8 على أحمد! الحق نفسك», «منى قلبت الإيدين بسبعة», «فاضلها كارت!»; the phones stay quiet. Sofa watchers get the story, not only the cards.

title: Rounds mode: the points fly to the winner
line: At a round's end in points mode each hand's cards fly from its seat to the winner (flyEmoji with a card back) while the winner's total counts up hand by hand, instead of a table of numbers; who paid most is felt.

title: Seat strip: show who is off screen
line: On an upright phone the opponents' strip scrolls sideways and fades at its edges; a seat at one card or with «امسكه!» open can sit outside it. Put a small badge on the faded edge («+3», red when one of them is at أونو) and let a tap scroll there.

title: Facing a stack: one clear bar
line: When +N waits on you, the bar shows one danger plate «عليك +6» with two equal buttons, «كدّس» (lights the cards that can) and «اسحب 6» (btn--danger), so the choice reads in one look at 375px and on a phone on its side.

title: Result screen: hands as one line each
line: After a one-round game the hands turn over for the table; at 8-12 players that is a long scroll on a phone. Show each player as one row (name, a small fan, the count) with a tap to open the full hand, and keep the podium first.

title: «الطباشير» chalk tally
line: The scores drawn the café way: on a small slate beside the table each side's points are chalk strokes in fives (four and a slash), the new strokes drawn in with a squeak; the number stays under it. Ours, Egyptian, and the TV's score strip becomes something to look at.

title: «إيه رأي الحريف؟» three hints
line: Each player may ask for three hints a game: their phone rings the tile the hard computer player would play and why in one line («بتخلّص الستات بدري»); the table sees «💡 استعان بالحريف» on the seat. A child learns beside grown-ups without switching helpers on for everyone.
warn: The helpers are the host's for the whole table (owner's spec); this is per player and visible, off unless the host allows

title: Double-nine set for 5-8
line: A set switch for a big family: the double-nine set (55 tiles), up to 8 players, 7 each, the same Egyptian scoring; the table layout already scales. The cousins who wait finally play.
warn: The owner's spec is 2-4 players with the double-six set; five or more can't start today

title: «القفلة بالضعف» house rule
line: A switch, off by default: a round won by a blocked table (قفلة) scores double for the side that takes it, as some cafés play; the قفلة band on the table gets a ×2 stamp.
warn: Blocked scoring is the owner's spec; this is an extra switch, off by default

title: «قرّب» race bar to the target
line: Under the score strip a thin bar per player or side shows how far they are to 101 (or 50), with the target as a flag; a side that passes three quarters gets a small pulse. A long game finally shows who is close.

title: Score keeper: «مين قفل؟» quick fills
line: On the على الطاولة score card, two quick buttons: «فلان خلّص» and «قفلة» ask only for the other hands' pips (or every hand's in a قفلة) and work out who takes what by the room game's own rules (dominoRoundResult), instead of typing the points by hand.

title: A tile that fits two ends: say it in the bar
line: Today the two ends glow on the table and in the bar; on a 375px phone the table's ends can be small. Show the picked tile big in the bar with two buttons «يمين ←» / «→ شمال» (or the four arms in أمريكاني, with the points each scores) so the second tap never misses.

title: Seats upright: name over the tiles
line: Three seats across an upright 375px phone keep a name, a row of backs and a count each; with the pass chip hung on the top edge the names truncate early. Show the count as a number badge on one back instead of the row of backs below 400px, so the name keeps its width.

title: «واحد مكشوف» house rule
line: A switch, off by default: every play must show one of its cards face up and the rest face down; one true card makes a lie look honest, and a shown card of another rank is a confession. A new layer of bluffing in one rule.

title: The tower that wobbles
line: The pile in the spotlight is drawn as a stack that grows taller and leans more with each play, wobbling when a call is made and collapsing toward the taker when it changes hands (transform only); on the TV the tower is the centre of the stage.

title: «كدّاب بالفرق» pairs
line: With 4, 6 or 8 people, partners sit opposite and win together when one goes out; you may not call your partner, and each pair gets one silent signal a round («صدّقه» / «اكشفه») shown only on the partner's phone. Bluffing for two.

title: «قول الحقيقة» rescue for the long hand
line: Whoever holds the most cards may, once a game, lay a play that can't be called (marked «حلفان» on the claim bubble) - but it must be true, checked by the server and shown at the end if anyone wonders. A way back from 30 cards.

title: Out players keep a buzzer
line: In «for places», a player already out can't call (owner's rule), but gets a small «😏» reaction button on each play that the TV shows as a growing laugh meter over the claim; a call that turns the play over shows how many smirked. They stay in the noise of the game.
warn: Only a player still holding cards can call (decided while building)

title: First game: «ممكن تكدب!» hint
line: For a phone's first game the follow bar shows a one-line nudge «مش لازم يكون معاك سبعات: ارمي أي ورق وقول سبعات» the first two times it has none of the rank, then never again; the rule new players don't believe.

title: Call window: show whose move closes it
line: With a person next (no bar), the chance to call ends silently when they move. Put «لحد ما منى تلعب» under the كدّاب! buzzer with the next seat's face, so everyone knows the window and who ends it.

title: Rank chips on a phone on its side
line: In 667x375 the 13 rank chips are two rows of 44x40 beside the hand; make them a single scrollable row of btn--sm chips with the ranks you hold first and their count badges, freeing a row for the hand.

title: «زقّ الكارت» the tease
line: The one being drawn from may push one card a little out of their hand (once a turn); the drawer sees that back stick up and must decide whether it is الشايب offered or a trap. The real table's gesture, done our way, public like a drag.

title: ش-ا-ي-ب: the evening match
line: Play again keeps a word: each loss earns one letter of «شايب» on your seat; whoever spells all four loses the evening and the TV crowns them «شايب السهرة» with the old man's fez. A long arc from five-minute games.

title: «رحلة الشايب» at the end
line: When الشايب turns over, the TV replays its journey: arrows seat to seat for every time it changed hands, counted («اتنقل ٧ مرات، ومنى خدته ٣»). The table finally learns who passed it to whom.

title: «الشايب والعجوزة» for big tables
line: A switch for 6-8 players: two odd cards in the deck, الشايب and العجوزة; whoever ends with either loses, with both a double loss. More tension when the deck is spread thin.
warn: The owner's spec: one الشايب card added

title: Safe players dress the old man
line: Players already safe get the old man's accessories to drop on any hand still playing (a fez, a stick, glasses - three in a game), shown on that seat for fun only; the loser's card at the end wears everything that landed on the final holder.

title: Your draw: the lifted card big
line: On an upright phone with 7+ backs in rows, the lifted card is gold but small. Echo it as a single large back above «خد الكارت ده» with «رقم ٤ من ٩» so the drawer sees what they are about to take before the second tap.

title: Waiting: «دورك بعد…»
line: With 6-8 players, a phone that is neither drawing nor drawn from shows a quiet line under its hand «بتسحب بعد ٣ أدوار · هتسحب من أحمد», so it knows whose hand to watch.

title: «جمجمة سريعة»: one bet wins
line: A lobby length: the first won bet wins the game (for 3-4 players or kids), a game in five minutes; the podium and night points as usual.

title: «اكشفوا الكل» after the round
line: A switch, off by default: once a round's result is shown, every pile turns face up for three seconds, so the table sees who laid a skull to bluff; the biggest laugh at a real table.
warn: Decided while building: every seat's flowers are alike so the table can't work out which disc a player lost; showing the piles tells whether a skull was laid, which hints what's still in hand

title: Heartbeat flips
line: During the flips the TV zooms a little on the next pile and a heartbeat plays faster as the flowers still needed shrink (فاضل ٢… فاضل ١); one beat of silence before the last flip.

title: «الجمجمة المشتركة» pairs for 6-8
line: Partners sit opposite and share a mat: a bet won by either counts for the pair, two wins the pair the game; you can't flip your partner's pile first. Big tables play shorter and talk more.

title: «القرص الدهبي» gold flower
line: A switch: once a game, at random, one player's hand gets a gold flower in place of a plain one (secret); turned over in a bet it counts as two flowers. One surprise that breaks the counting.
warn: The owner's spec: 4 discs, 3 flowers and a skull

title: Bet picker: say what a number means
line: The bet's number chips are bare numbers; under the picked chip write «لازم تقلب ٤ ورود: كل قرصك + ١ من غيرك» from your own pile's size, so a first-timer understands the bet before sending it.

title: «هيعملها؟» bigger and alone
line: The 8-second ✅ / ❌ sits in the bar with the draining line; make it a centred two-button card (btn--lg success / danger) over the table for the phones that answer, with the bidder's name and bet, so nobody misses the 8 seconds while looking at the piles.

title: Phone on its side: piles in one row
line: At 667x375 the seat cards stack and push the bar under the fold; lay the seats as one row of compact tiles (avatar, pile count, turned discs) beside your discs and the bar.

title: «لعب على المكشوف» teaching table
line: A lobby switch for a practice game: every hand is open on every screen (bots included), the bar says in one line why a trick was won («الطرنيب بيكسب الشكل»), and the game doesn't count on the night. The way grandpa teaches at a real table, with the cards turned up.

title: «الريسك» on the seat
line: The last caller's seat wears a red rope badge «ريسك» and, once the calls close, the TV shows «لازم يجيبها» or «لازم يكسرها» over it; it ticks red the moment the risk can no longer be made. The seat everyone watches gets marked.

title: «التالي لوحده» between rounds
line: A lobby switch: after a round's result the next deal comes by itself after 12 s with a countdown and «⏸ استنى», the same engine as the party games; the host's tap stays the default.
warn: Decided: the next round is the host's tap (a pause the table uses to read); this is a switch, off by default

title: «اللمّات» swipe at the round's end
line: On the round's result a small strip lets anyone swipe back through the round's 13 tricks (who led, who took, the trump that won), so the table can argue over the trick that broke a call.

title: The fifth seat partners a bot
line: With five people, the fifth sits beside a computer seat as its «مساعد»: they see that hand and may tap a suggestion the bot follows once a trick; the room's guest is in the game, not on the sofa.
warn: Decided: with more than four, four play and the rest watch

title: Auction picker: two rows, one tap
line: The bid picker shows numbers and drawn suits; make it numbers as one row of btn--sm chips and the five suits as one row of big suit tiles, with the current high bid written above («أعلى: ٥ ♥ - لازم ٥ ♠ أو أكتر») so the legal choice is obvious.

title: Took / called as a progress pip row
line: The took / called chip on each seat (2/3) is small at 375px; draw it as pips (filled for taken, rings for still needed, a red ring once impossible) so the whole table reads in one look on a phone and the TV.

title: Rounds sheet on a phone on its side
line: At 667x375 the 18-round sheet is a tall table; show the last five rounds and the totals, with «كل الجولات» opening the rest in a centred sheet.

title: Fix: no podium for كونكان or teams
line: csFinalHtml (JS_CardScore.html) builds the podium only when !team && !g.low, so كونكان, طرنيب ٤١ and every team game end on a 🏆 line; give كونكان a lowest-first podium (as سكرو's skPodiumHtml) and teams a two-sides crown with the partners' names, with afterReveal's confetti.

title: The score on the TV
line: «اعرض على الشاشة»: the score keeper opens a room as a screen-only table, and the TV shows the live totals, the dealer and the last round with count-ups while the phone keeps typing; a family playing طرنيب with real cards gets a scoreboard on the wall.

title: Count the night in الشلة
line: At a finished game, «سجّل للشلة» records it on the crew's night (places by the final totals, 5/3/2/1), so a family whose evening is real cards still has its champion of the month.
warn: الشلة: one-phone games never count (crew.md)

title: باصرة: count as you go
line: A live strip during the deck: a +1 basra button per player and a «الأرض خلصت» step, so basras are tapped as they happen and the round card arrives with them filled in; only the most cards, the aces, jacks and the two special cards are left to type.

title: The game's line at the end
line: The final card draws a small line chart of each total round by round (an SVG, the players' colours), so the table sees when the comeback happened; shared with the result.

title: Share the final sheet
line: «📸 شارك» on the finished game makes the same share card the rooms use (JS_ShareCard) with the game's name, the podium and the rounds, for the family's WhatsApp group.

title: Round card: big steppers first
line: On a 375px phone the round card's steppers, pick chips and toggles mix sizes; put each seat's main number (tricks, cards, points) as one full-width stepper row with the name on its start side, and the extras (dash, kaboot, doubles) folded under «أكتر»; one column, the sticky Save always in sight.

title: Sideways: totals beside, not above
line: At 667x375 the totals and history sit beside the round card (.cs-layout); keep the totals column to a fixed share (40%) with the leader's crown visible and the history folded, so the round card isn't squeezed to a sliver.

title: Themed boards like السلم والتعبان's
line: The same rules on dressed boards: «الحارة» (yards as houses, a ful cart crossing), «النيل» (feluccas on the track, the home a pyramid), drawn on the classic cross; picked in the lobby or 🎲. The board stops looking like every other Ludo app.

title: The pieces as little people
line: The app's cartoon cast (السلم والتعبان's) as the pieces, in their colour: they cheer a 6, flinch when a piece behind is in reach, and the captured one stomps back to the yard. Every capture becomes a scene.

title: Roll by shaking
line: On your turn a shake of the phone rolls (the die starts tumbling with the shake; the number is still the server's), with the button kept; iPhone's motion permission is asked once from a tap in the setup.

title: «هدية» from the finished
line: A player who got home gets one gift to give: a re-roll handed to anyone still playing, used whenever they like; the TV shows who gave it. Finished players stay part of the fight.

title: The TV zooms on a capture
line: A capture or a piece reaching home: the TV's board scales into that square for a second and back (transform only), so the sofa sees the hit, then the bursting yard.

title: Six seats: «لودو الستة»
line: A switch for 5-6 players: the six-arm board (a hexagonal track with six yards), same rules; the family's fifth and sixth play instead of the host benching them.
warn: The owner's spec: 2-4 players; with five or more the host picks who plays

title: Movable pieces: lift them on your phone
line: After your roll the pieces you can move should rise and pulse on your own board (and the rest dim), with the squares each would reach on long-press; the bar says «اختار حجر» with the count. Today a mouse shows the path but a finger has no preview.

title: Bar: the die and the line together
line: On an upright phone the bar's line «دورك» sits apart from the die; put the die as the roll button itself (btn--lg, 46% of the bar like السلم والتعبان's) and the result text beside it, so one look says roll or move.

title: Clock ring on the player up
line: With a turn clock on, draw it as a ring round the player's chip in the strip (and their yard on the TV), not only a number, so the sofa sees time running on the right person.

title: «سؤال على السلم»
line: A switch, off by default: landing on a ladder's foot asks one quick question from the trivia bank (TriviaQuestions.js, the easy level, four choices, 10 s) on the roller's phone and the TV; right, climb; wrong, stay. The game gets a moment that is yours, and the questions come from the app's biggest list.
warn: Owner chose "pure classic" (28 Sep); like the surprises this is an extra switch, off

title: «لوحة صغيرة» 8x8 for kids
line: A board size: 64 squares with four snakes and four ladders, the same fairness check scaled; a game in five minutes for a four-year-old.

title: The finished place one surprise
line: In a game for places, a player home gets one surprise object to stand on any empty square ahead of the others (the peel, the pillow or the star from the surprise squares); everyone sees whose it was when it bites.

title: «خريطتنا» keep a map
line: «احفظ الخريطة دي» on a board the family liked keeps its seed (and theme) by name; the lobby offers «خرايطنا» beside 🎲. Free: a map is a seed the server already stores.

title: «الأخير يرمي زهرين»
line: A switch: whoever is 30+ squares behind the leader rolls two dice and takes the better one; their piece wears a small 🍀. Keeps the last player in it without changing the map.

title: Roll by shaking
line: A shake of the phone rolls the die on your turn, the tap kept; the motion permission is asked once from a tap. The one physical act the game has, done like real dice.

title: Teams: show who rolls for whom
line: When a member home rolls for the teammate furthest behind, the roll button says «ترمي لـ منى» with her face, and her piece pulses on the board; today the turn line names the roller, and the piece that moves is a surprise.

title: Setup: the switches explained by a picture
line: The surprise and moving-map switches have a hint line; put a tiny looping preview beside each (the peel spinning, a snake crawling) using the objects already drawn, so a parent picks without reading.

title: The awards' replay: skip to the recap
line: The «لقطة» replay runs up to three clips before the recap; add «تخطّى ←» beside ✕ that jumps to «أبطال اللعبة», so a table that wants play again isn't stuck behind it on the host's phone.

title: «الثروة» race on the TV
line: A bar per player along the TV's edge showing worth (cash + places + buildings, as the end counts it), bars sliding as rent is paid (scaleX, countUp); at the last lap they grow taller. The 45 minutes finally have a scoreboard.

title: «موسم» events from the board itself
line: Every three laps a season card falls on the TV: one colour group drawn at random gets «موسم الساحل: الإيجار ×2 لفة» or «ركود في الصعيد: نص الإيجار», named from the group's own cities (no new list). A board that changes mid-game.

title: «سلفة» from the bank
line: Once a game, a player may take a loan of 300 paid back as 350 at their next pass of Start (taken automatically, a debt if short); a comeback for the one who landed on القاهرة with a سوق.

title: Tap a place to make an offer
line: Tapping a square another player owns, on your turn, shows «اعرض تشتريها» on its card in the middle; it opens 🤝 with that place already in «هتاخد» and a starting price of its value. Two taps instead of building the offer from lists.

title: Fix: a table left with only computer players
line: In "until one is left", once every person is bankrupt or gone the computer players play on (bankFinish is only reached when one is active, BankAlhaz.js ~918, and bots never trade); end the game on worth when nobody but computer players is still in.

title: «غطّي الدين» one tap
line: When a debt waits, the bar offers «غطّي الدين» which shows the plan the computer would use (bankRaise: which buildings sold, which places mortgaged) in a centred sheet and does it on «تمام»; the 🏗️ panel stays for doing it by hand.

title: Players under the board: one row on a phone
line: On an upright 375px phone the players' list under the board pushes the bar down; make it one horizontal row of chips (piece, cash with countUp, 🔄 and jail marks), the player up ringed, so board, players and bar fit 667px tall.

title: The card in the middle: what to do now
line: The middle shows the square landed on; when a buy waits, put the price and «معاك ٨٢٠» on the card and the two buttons («اشتري» primary, «سيبها» ghost) under it on the board itself on laptop and TV, so eyes don't jump from the board to the bar.

title: «عمّو ضد الكل» - a simul
line: A room way inside the chess card: one player (the strong one) plays everyone else at once, each opponent on their own phone and board; the simul-giver's phone walks from board to board in order, and the TV shows all boards as live cards with the score «عمّو 3 - العيلة 1». The family plays together instead of waiting in line.

title: «سلّم الشخصيات» - beat them one by one
line: A ladder against the six characters: beat نونو to unlock عم حسن, and so on up to الجنرال, with up to three stars a rung (win, win without undo, win in under 40 moves) and each character's face lighting up on a wall in أرقامي. Gives the slider a story and a reason to come back.

title: «احفظ افتتاحك» - an opening drill
line: Pick one of the 150 openings the app already knows (الإيطالي, الصقلي…); the computer plays the other side's book moves and you must answer with the book's, a wrong move shows the right one with a pen arrow and you try again; three clean runs mark it learnt. Turns the opening names into something a learner keeps.

title: «ماتش على راحتك» - a slow game across days
line: Two relatives in different houses or countries play one game over days: the game is kept by a 6-letter code like «اعمل مسابقتك» (the /pack store), each opens the app when they like, sees «دورك» on the chess card and moves; no clock, the last 5 moves replayed on opening. Fits the family abroad, costs one small record.
warn: No Web Push (Decided, and why: not built on purpose) - the turn is seen only when the app is opened

title: «المعلّق» on the TV
line: In a room duel the TV prints one short line after notable moves from the reasons the engine already writes («الحصان عمل شوكة!», «الوزير ساب مكانه مكشوف») in a ticker under the board, giving the watchers something to cheer; the players' phones never show it.
warn: The coach is against the computer only, «unfair against a person» (the owner's spec): the TV's lines must describe what happened, never suggest the next move

title: «ضريبة الكرسي» for a long reign
line: In winner stays, a champion on 🔥3 gives the challenger the handicap of the challenger's choice (the f-pawn, a knight, half the clock) until they lose; the handicap code already exists. Keeps a strong uncle in the chair without the rest giving up.
warn: Batch 2: in a room «the champion gives» the handicap only when the host picks one; this makes it automatic after a streak

title: Room screen: say who is next before the game ends
line: On a watcher's phone in winner stays, the strip under the board says nothing about the line until the result card; add a slim chip «بعد الماتش: انت» / «انت التالت في الدور» under the opponent bar (upright layout 1A), so a watcher knows when to get ready and doesn't wander off.

title: Result card: one primary action, not a row of equals
line: At a room game's end the phone shows the result line, the review, the share row and the next-game button with similar weight; make «الماتش الجاي» the .btn--primary btn--lg, the review a .btn--secondary and the three share buttons one «📤 شارك» that opens the existing share choices in a centred popup - fewer buttons at 375px.

title: Setup: say what the chosen character is like before Start
line: On the one-phone setup the six faces sit beside a slider; the chosen one's line («بيحب الكش») is small and easy to miss in English dark at 1280x720. Show the picked character as a card above Start with its face, rating, its one line and whether the game will be rated (the line that is already worked out), so the choice is confirmed where the thumb is.

title: Sideways phone: the clock where the eye is
line: At 667x375 the two clocks sit in the slim player bars at the column's top and bottom; in a timed game the running one should grow and turn the accent (and --danger under 10 s) with a soft pulse, since on a sideways phone the eye stays on the board, far from the column.

title: «الملك في النص» - king of the hill
line: A lobby variant: a king reaching one of the four middle squares and surviving a full round wins (teams) or scores +20 (everyone for themselves). Short, aggressive games with a clear goal kids understand.

title: Team whisper channel
line: In teams, the room chat gets the team channel that أسماء الرموز and شطرنج بالتصويت already have (roomChatTeam), with three quick lines («خلي بالك من الأزرق», «هاجم الأخضر», «احميني»), so partners plan without the other team hearing.

title: «الروح» - the knocked-out player stays in
line: In everyone for themselves, a player who is out becomes a ghost: once per round they may name one grey wall piece to vanish, opening a line - a small say in the game and a reason to keep watching.
warn: The owner's rule: an out player's pieces are grey walls that neither move nor can be taken

title: Speed round «دور سريع»
line: A clock choice of 10 seconds a move (on the server's clock, an easy computer move when it runs out, as the first move's 45 s does) so a round of four takes under a minute; a fast family version.

title: The TV's «مين متقدم» bar
line: Everyone for themselves: a horizontal bar on the TV made of the four colours sized by points, sliding with countUp as captures land (points already fly to chips), so the room feels the race without reading four numbers.

title: Phone: whose turn as a ring round the board
line: With four players the pulsing ring on a 72px corner chip is easy to miss at 375px; also tint the board's outer frame in the colour to move and show «دورك!» as the status's first word in that colour, so the turn is clear without hunting the corner.

title: Corner chips: two lines, not five things
line: At 375x667 each cut-corner chip holds colour, name, points, clock, the ring and «برّه»; show name and clock only, and put points in the status line on tap of the chip (a small centred popup of the four scores), so the chips read at a glance.

title: Lobby cross: say what a tap does
line: The host's seat cross works by «tap two to swap» with no words on it; add a one-line hint under the cross that changes with the step («اضغط على لون، بعدين على التاني عشان يتبدلوا» → «اختار مكانه»), and pop the swapped chips with flipGrid.

title: «الكابتن» breaks the tie
line: Each team picks a captain in the lobby (the host's tap, or random); a tie goes to the move the captain voted for, and the captain's chip wears a band. A family knows who decides.
warn: Decided: a tie is drawn at random among the tied moves

title: «الفيتو» - once per game
line: Each member may once a game veto the winning move just before it is played: the vote reopens for 10 seconds without that move, the TV flashes «فيتو من منى!». Drama, accusation and laughter, one use each.

title: «شوفوا أصواتنا» switch
line: A lobby switch: teammates see each other's arrows live while voting (the other team still sees only who voted), so a team argues over the board rather than shouting across the room.
warn: Decided: votes secret until the move is played (who voted public, not for what)

title: Team bank clock «ساعة الفريق»
line: Instead of a fixed 20/30/60 a vote, each team gets a bank (5 or 10 minutes) spent while it votes; quick votes on obvious recaptures save time for the hard moment.

title: «مين كان معانا؟» streaks
line: Keep, per member, how many of their votes became the team's move, shown as a small number on their name in the pills and counted up at the end - a gentle score for the quiet member whose votes keep winning.

title: Your vote, visible after you cast it
line: After a vote the piece goes back and only a blue premove-colour arrow stays, which on the 2D board at 375px is thin; add a chip under the board «صوتك: ♞f3 · تقدر تغيّره» with a ✕ to take it back, so the voter knows it counted and can change it.

title: Waiting team's screen
line: While the other team votes, the waiting phones show the board and a status line only; dim the board slightly, show the other team's vote ring with how many voted («٣ من ٥ صوّتوا»), and a soft «استنى دوركم» so nobody taps and wonders why nothing happens.

title: TV tally as bars
line: The TV's tally card lists moves as text (♞f3 ×3); draw it through renderVoteResults (bars in suspense, winner last) so the room sees the split land the way every other vote in the app does.

title: Pairs on the bench - winner pair stays
line: With five or more people, pairs wait in a line: the losing pair stands up and the next pair sits, the winners keep their colours (the duels' winner stays, for pairs). Everyone plays across the night.
warn: Decided: more than four people and the rest watch

title: «بدّلوا!» at move 20
line: A lobby switch: at move 20 the TV calls «بدّلوا!» and Brain and Hand swap roles in the same game, with a short pop on every phone. The weaker half gets a turn at thinking mid-game.
warn: Decided: roles fixed for a game, swapped for the next

title: «لمست تلعب» - touch move
line: A switch: once the Hand lifts a piece (the touch already sent to the server), they must move that piece. Real-club tension and laughter when the Hand grabs the wrong knight.

title: The Hand's thumbs up
line: After the call the Hand may tap 👍 or 🤔 (public, shown beside the Brain's word on every screen) - one tap of feedback the table enjoys, no hint of the move.

title: Brain's buttons: bigger and in one row on every size
line: The six kind buttons on the Brain's phone sit under the board; at 667x375 make them a column beside the board (the side column of layout 6A) at the .btn size of 48px, with the faded kinds also crossed out, so a Brain never taps a dead kind.

title: Say the role on the screen's top line
line: A seated phone shows the pills with 🧠/✋ but the status line can say «فريقك بيفكّر»; make the first line always «انت المخ - سمّي قطعة» or «انت الإيد - استنى المخ» in the accent, with the waiting state dimmed, so a first-timer knows their job.

title: Recall countdown as a ring on the call card
line: The 3 s change window is a small count; draw it as a ring draining round the big call card on the Brain's and the Hand's phones, so the Hand sees why their board is not yet live.

title: The time-gap chip «متقدم ٢٠ ث»
line: Beside your clock, a chip shows your time minus your opponent's (+20 green, -15 red), and the same for your partner's board; the core bughouse decision (stall or move) becomes visible to a family.

title: «إنزال قاتل» hint switch
line: For beginners, a lobby switch: a piece in hand that can drop with check glows, and one that mates pulses gold. Teaches what drops are for, never on by default.

title: Winning team stays
line: With six or eight people, the losing team stands up and the next two sit down as a team (in order), the winners staying - everyone plays and the line moves fast with 3-minute games.
warn: Decided: more than four play the first four of a random order and the rest watch; play again turns the partners round

title: «بنزّل من السما» - a parachute drop on the TV
line: On the TV, a drop lands from above the board with a small shadow growing and a thud, and the piece crossing from the other board leaves a trail between the two boards - the flight across is the game's signature, made big for the room.

title: Partner board: live and named
line: The small partner board is a static flat board; show its last move's squares in yellow, its two clocks under it and the partner's hand as small counts (♞2 ♙1), so a glance tells you what is coming without swapping sizes.

title: Hand as a tray, not a row of buttons
line: Your hand's pieces are live 44px buttons in the player line; at 375px with five kinds they wrap. Show them as a tray directly under your board with a count badge on each piece, the tray lit in the accent when it is your move.

title: Stuck side: say it
line: When you have no move and nothing to drop, the board just waits with the clock running; show a centred note over the board «مفيش حركة - استنى قطعة من شريكك» and pulse your partner's chip, so the player doesn't tap around.

title: «انقذ نفسك» - defence puzzles
line: A new kind from the same build tool: positions where only one move saves the game (stops a mate or keeps the queen); its own tag and a shield icon, mixed into the free puzzles as a choice. Trains the half of chess the bank leaves out.

title: «كمّلها» - finish the job
line: After a material puzzle is solved, a button plays the position on against the computer (الكابتن) for up to 15 moves to see the win through; a mate or keeping the advantage gives a second star.

title: «اللي غلبوني» - the retry pile
line: Every puzzle you got wrong or gave up on goes into a pile on the setup screen (kept on the phone), retried later; solving it twice in a row clears it. A gentle way to learn from misses.

title: «لغز الكنبة» - pass and play
line: A family mode on one phone: 2-4 names take turns on puzzles of their own level (a kid easy, the father hard), a point per first-try solve, ten puzzles, a podium at the end.

title: Say who you play as, big
line: The side to move is the player, but at a glance a learner can't tell; show «انت الأبيض - العب واكسب» or «انت الأسود» as the first line with a small piece icon, and turn the board so your side is at the bottom (if any puzzle shows it the other way, that is a fix).

title: Streak: hearts and score together
line: In the streak the hearts and the score sit in different places on an upright phone; put them in one bar above the board (♥♥♡ · 12) using the player bar of layout 1A, so a lost heart's jump is seen where the eye is.

title: Wrong move: say what was missed after the third try
line: After a wrong move the piece shakes back with no words; after two wrong tries, offer the motif hint automatically as a soft line («فكّر في كش») rather than needing the 💡 button.

title: «بوب أوت» - pull a disc out
line: A rule choice: on your turn you may instead pull one of your own discs from the bottom row, the column dropping down. Changes the whole game, same board and motion (the disc slides out the bottom).

title: «صدّة!» - the block, celebrated
line: When a drop fills a column where the other side would have won next, a gloved 🧤 flies to the disc (flyEmoji) with «صدّة!» and a thud; blocks are counted and the best blocker is named at the end of a room night.

title: An optional think clock for winner stays
line: A host lobby choice: off / 15 / 30 seconds a disc; at 0 the server drops a safe column (c4SafeCol, already written for teams). Stops one slow player holding the line.

title: Kids' board «بورد صغير»
line: A 5x4 board with three in a row: short games for a five-year-old against an easy phone, same look and motion.

title: «ماتش لـ ٣» on one phone
line: Pick a match length (first to 3 or 5) at the setup; the pills count up and the match ends on the podium with confetti instead of an endless tally.

title: Aim disc: tap a column, then confirm on small screens
line: At 375px the columns are ~45px and a slip drops in the wrong one with no take-back (the owner's rule); add a setting-free safeguard: a quick tap moves the ghost disc to that column and a second tap on the same column drops, while a press-and-drag-release drops at once as today.
warn: No take-backs on one phone (the owner: «never»)

title: Who starts the next game, before it starts
line: On one phone the next game is started by whoever went second, but the result card doesn't say it; add «الماتش الجاي يبدأ: هند 🟡» on the result card with her pill pulsing.

title: Teams relay on the TV: the member up, big
line: In team mode the TV shows the relay as two boxes; make the member up a large name with their 20 s ring beside the board, so the room knows who to shout at.

title: «سر اللعبة» - the chain tip
line: A short help card in 📘 and once after a loss to the hard phone: «اللي يفتح السلسلة الطويلة الأول بيخسر» with a 4-frame drawn example; the rule that turns the game from luck to skill.

title: Combo counter on a chain «×٥»
line: Each box taken in one run raises a counter by the board (×2, ×3…) with a rising pitch and countUp, ending with a stamp «سلسلة ٥!»; the big endgame grab becomes a moment.

title: Kids' 3x3
line: A 3x3 size for young players and a two-minute game, against easy or a friend.

title: Think clock for rooms
line: Off / 20 / 40 seconds a line, host's choice; at 0 the server draws a safe line (one that gives no third side if any exists).

title: «الضلع الممنوع» - one blocked line
line: A surprise switch: at the start each player secretly marks one line the other may never draw (shown only on the owner's phone in rooms); changes the endgame count and adds a guessing layer.

title: 8x8 at 375px: the loupe or a zoom
line: Lines on 8x8 are ~40px apart at 375px and the finger hides them; show the faint pressed line plus a small magnifier above the finger like شطرنج الأربعة's loupe (ch4LoupeShow), only for a finger and only below 34px spacing.

title: Say «اللعب تاني» when you took a box
line: After taking a box the same player moves again; on one phone the ring stays and the pill pulses, which is subtle. Add a short line under the board «قفلت مربع - العب تاني!» that pops in each time.

title: Score during the endgame: a box count bar
line: Upright, the pills show box counts; add a thin two-colour bar under the pills (blue vs rose, widths by boxes taken, remaining boxes grey) so the table sees who is ahead as the chains fall.

title: «اللي يكمّل يخسر» - misère
line: A rule switch: three in a row loses. Grown-ups who always draw suddenly lose by accident; the hard phone plays it right.

title: «إكس أو الطويل» - five in a row
line: A third size: an open 11x11 grid, five in a row wins, both players' marks with the same pen stroke; the Egyptian notebook game of the school back row, inside the X-O card.

title: «الحركة الذهبية» - one swap
line: With the 3-marks switch: once a game, swap one of your marks with an adjacent opponent's mark. A comeback tool that breaks the endless dance.

title: «إكس أو وتلت» - three players
line: A room way for three: ✕, ◯ and △ on a 5x5 grid, three in a row wins, turns going round; two players can block each other while the third sneaks a line - laughter and accusations instead of a sure draw. On the TV the three pills sit beside the grid.

title: Send arrow on the big board
line: After a move on «إكس أو الكبير», a short arrow travels from the square just played to the board it sends to (transform/opacity only), and the status names the place; the rule explains itself the first few times.

title: Refused tap: explain on the board
line: Tapping a square on a board you weren't sent to does nothing on one phone; shake that board softly and pulse the target board with a toast «العب في اللوحة المنورة», as the room already says on the server's refusal.

title: 3 marks: label the fading one once
line: The first time a player has three marks, put a small tag on the faded one «دي هتمشي» for that turn only, so new players learn the rule from the board.

title: «كاس الترضية» - the losers' cup
line: Everyone knocked out in round 1 is drawn straight into a second small bracket played at the same time; its winner gets a bronze cup on the podium and a point on the night. Nobody sits out after one game.

title: «دوري» - everyone plays everyone
line: A second format from 3 people: a round robin with a points table (win 3, draw 1), matches running two at a time, the table sliding with animateScoreboards; best for 3-6 people.
warn: Decided: the switch shows only from 4 people

title: Final on three
line: A lobby switch: the final is best of three, the TV counting «١ - ٠» between games with the bracket's crown waiting.

title: Seeds from the night
line: A switch «التصنيف»: the two top people on the night's board are placed in opposite halves of the bracket, so they meet in the final - said on the draw («المصنف الأول»).
warn: Decided: the draw of the pairs is random

title: «بطولة المكس» - a different duel each round
line: The host picks a line-up (X-O in round 1, كونكت ٤ in the semis, شطرنج in the final), like «خماسي السهرة»; the bracket shows each round's game icon.

title: Out-of-the-tournament phone: one clear card
line: A knocked-out phone shows the bracket; put a card on top «خرجت في الدور الأول · اتفرج على:» with the live matches as big tappable chips (not the small picker), so the next thing to do is one tap.

title: Bracket at 375px: scroll to your match
line: With 8 entrants the bracket's columns are wider than the phone; open it scrolled to the round being played with your own row highlighted in the accent, and a «أنا فين؟» chip to jump back.

title: Countdown to your next match
line: While waiting for a match whose players aren't known, show «ماتشك الجاي ضد الفايز من (منى × أحمد)» with that match's live mini board, so the wait has a face.

title: «سلّم الموبايل» - two on one phone
line: A pass-and-play way: each places behind a curtain card («سلّم الموبايل لهند - ماتبصّش!»), and every turn starts with the curtain so only the shooter's view shows; the hold-card pattern the role games already use.
warn: The owner's spec: a room and against the phone (hidden information); one phone needs the curtain to keep it

title: «صلية» - salvo
line: A lobby/setup choice: each turn fire as many shells as you have ships afloat, all in the air together, results told when they land. Faster games, a comeback rule for the side ahead in ships.

title: «أقل طلقات» - your record
line: Against the phone, the fewest shots you needed to sink each level's fleet is kept and shown on the result («٤٢ طلقة - رقمك الأحسن ٣٩»), counted up.

title: Hunt helper for kids
line: A setup switch: after a hit, the squares where the ship can continue get a faint dot (bsTargetCells), off by default.

title: Aim button: fixed place, big
line: The two-tap fire shows «🔥 اضرب B7»; make it one fixed .btn--primary btn--lg under the sea that is always there on your turn (disabled «اختار مربع» until aimed), so the thumb learns one place.

title: Fleet status as ship silhouettes
line: Under the seas, show both fleets as five small ship silhouettes with hits as red dots and sunk ones greyed, instead of words; readable at 375px and on the TV from the sofa.

title: Placing at 375px: the ship under the finger
line: Dragging a ship hides its footprint under the thumb; lift the ship a little above the finger while dragging (as the chess drag lifts) and show «اضغط عليها عشان تلف» once on the first ship.

title: «جولة سريعة» - three balls each
line: A room way for big tables: three balls each on a full rack every time, total pins; done in a few minutes with a podium, between longer games.

title: «البين الدهب» - the golden pin
line: A switch: before each frame one pin is lit gold on every screen; knocking it down adds 5 pins. A surprise that can swing a game and makes a spare worth chasing.

title: «تسعة تبقى استرايك» - no-tap for kids
line: A per-player choice: nine pins on the first ball count as a strike, marked on the card. Kids get strikes and the sheet stays honest.

title: First-throw demo hand
line: The first time on a phone, a drawn hand shows the gesture on the lane (pull back, swing, let go) in a loop until the first touch, with one line «اسحب لورا، وارمي لقدام».

title: Your turn: a call-up card
line: In a room the turn passes quietly; show a short centred card «دورك يا منى! 🎳» that slides in and away on the thrower's phone, with the lane waking up, so a phone on the table gets noticed.

title: Sideways phone: the sheet as names and totals plus the current frame
line: At 667x375 the column shows names and totals only; add the current frame's marks (X, /, 7) beside each name, so the thrower knows whether this is the second ball.

title: Pin cam on the TV
line: As the ball reaches the pins, the TV opens a small picture-in-picture from above the deck for the crash, then closes it; the room sees exactly which pins stayed.

title: «ماتش بلاي» - hole by hole
line: A scoring choice: each hole is won by the fewest strokes (a point, shared on a tie), the total is holes won; a bad hole costs one point, not the game. Keeps beginners in it.

title: «أقرب للحفرة» - one-putt contest
line: A quick room way: each round everyone gets one putt from the tee on a hole; closest to the cup (or in) scores; five holes, a podium. Five minutes of shouting.

title: «رحلة مصر» - a 9-hole tour
line: A fixed course from the existing holes ordered as a trip (Alex's lighthouse → Cairo Tower → the Citadel → the pyramid → the Nile → Siwa → Sinai → the temple → the port), a small map card between holes with the ball travelling the route.
warn: Decided: the order is never a fixed one (holes drawn at random) - this adds one named fixed course

title: «تي الصغيرين» - a forward tee
line: A per-player choice: a kid tees from a point halfway along the path (golfField), marked as a small yellow tee; their card shows 🐣.

title: TV flyover of the course
line: Before the first hole the TV flies the camera over each hole of the game for a second with its name card, then lands on hole 1 - the room sees the evening ahead.

title: Power as a number and a ring
line: The pull arrow turns green to red; add a small % next to the ball and a faint ring at full pull, so a player learns their strength and can repeat a good putt.

title: All at once: show who is still putting
line: In 'all at once' the players' chips at the foot don't say who is done; tick a chip with ✓ and the strokes when its ball drops, and pulse the last one still out («منى لسه بتلعب»), so the room knows why the hole hasn't moved on.

title: Strip at 375px: less at once
line: The top strip holds hole name, level chip and «المطلوب 3 · أقصى 6» over the course; on an upright phone show the hole number and «٢/٦ ضربات» only, and the rest in the name card that flies in, so the course gets the top of the screen.

title: Up to four players, with their names
line: The duo becomes 2-4 players taken from the name picker («مين بيلعب؟»), each with a colour chip; a found pair flies to its finder's chip (flyEmoji) and the end is a podium - three cousins can play, and the board says whose turn it is by name.

title: «ذاكرة الأصوات»
line: A theme where each card plays one of the soundboard's sounds instead of showing a picture (the face shows 🔊); pairs are found by ear - a new skill, our own twist, no new content (the soundboard's sounds already exist).

title: Stars against the perfect game
line: Solo shows a par for the size (the moves a perfect memory would need plus a margin) and gives 1-3 ⭐ by moves; the stars count up on the result - a number that finally means something.

title: «بص ثلاث ثواني» peek start for kids
line: A «للصغيرين» switch shows every card face up for three seconds at the start, then they turn back in a wave from the corner - small children get a fair chance beside parents.

title: «ذاكرة النهارده»
line: A seeded daily board (16 cards, the theme of the day) scored by moves, in تحدي اليوم with a share line «🎴 18 حركة» - the same cards for the whole family.

title: Fix: the result through soloResult
line: JS_Memory.html's memoryFinish fills its own #memory-result-modal: move it to soloResult (count-up, «شوف اللوحة», again/exit) so it behaves like every other solo game, and keep the best per size as it is.

title: Big board laid out for a phone on its side
line: The 30-card board is 5 columns × 6 rows (MEMORY_SIZES.l) on every screen; sideways (667×375) and on a laptop it should be 6 or 10 columns wide so cards stay big instead of shrinking to fit the height.

title: Whose turn, impossible to miss
line: In two-player play the turn is only a class on a small chip (.mem-player.is-turn); tint the whole board's edge with the player's colour and slide the turn highlight between chips (like duelPillsAfter) when the turn passes.

title: A card back that is the app's
line: The back is a plain «?» (mem-card__face--back): draw the app's mark or the theme's emoji faint on the accent, so the board looks like ours in light and dark, and a matched pair dims with a ✓ so the open cards read at a glance.

title: Fix: hide the friend's secret
line: #gn-secret in Controller.html is a plain number field, so the digits show while typed; make it a .secret-field with its dots and eye (as المشنقة's word, GEMINI *Traps*: hide typed text that way everywhere).

title: A par and a best per range
line: Show «تقدر تجيبها في 7» (the halving count for the range), end on soloResult with the tries counting up, ⭐ for at or under par, and keep a best per range through soloRecord.

title: «مين أقل محاولات» duel on one phone
line: Two players each type a secret for the other (dots), then guess in turns, each with their own window and man; fewest tries wins the round, first to 3 - a couch duel out of the existing pieces.

title: Range presets as chips
line: Replace the two fields with chips 1-10 (kids), 1-100, 1-1000, 1-1,000,000 and «مخصص» to open the fields - one tap instead of editing two numbers, and the million range is a real brag.

title: Eastern Arabic digits switch
line: A switch shows the range, chips and the man's numbers as ١٢٣ (the number pad still types either) - a game for kids learning their numbers at school.

title: Labelled range fields and no one-off sizes
line: The setup's min/max have no labels and English placeholders, and the play card uses text-xl font-bold mb-6 on #gn-feedback; use .field + .field__label («من» / «لحد») and the design system's sizes, and give the feedback an empty state instead of «...».

title: The window as a bar, not only numbers
line: Draw the still-possible range as a bar over the full range that shrinks (scaleX) with each guess and the guess as a tick on it - at 375px the eye reads «where is it» faster than «بين 37 و 52».

title: Sideways: the man beside the field
line: At 667×375 the man, the feedback and the field stack in one tall card that needs a scroll; put the man on one side and the field with the chips on the other so a guess never scrolls the keyboard off.

title: Fix: the archive's «all done» for that day
line: renderDailyArchive in JS_Daily.html compares doneCount with DAILY_GAMES.length, which includes switched-off dailies and ones added later (mini golf, chess puzzle), so a day before they existed can never be complete; count the dailies that were live on that day (and dailyLive today).

title: «قارن نتيجتك» from a shared message
line: The share text carries a short link with the day's results encoded (tries, times - no names); opening it after finishing your own shows the two side by side with count-ups - no server, the family's WhatsApp group becomes the scoreboard.

title: Against your own average
line: After each daily, one line «أسرع من متوسطك بـ ٤٠ ثانية» or «في ٣ زي عادتك», from the two months already kept in ashryDaily_v1 - a personal yardstick without accounts.

title: «يومي أنا» - your order
line: A ⋯ on the hub lets you put favourites first and fold the ones you never play under «الباقي» (folded, never removed); the count and the streak still read every daily.
warn: Everything built stays (folds only)

title: The month's card
line: On the 1st, the last month as a card: days with a daily, the best streak, the game you played most and your best result, counting up, ready to share - a monthly moment from data already kept.

title: Rows that show today's state at a glance
line: Each row should be one of three clear states - «العب» (accent), «كمّل» (amber with a small progress ring) and done (its result line in green, the row dimmed) - instead of rows that differ only in their button text.

title: Two columns from 900px
line: On a laptop or TV the hub is one long column of fourteen rows; from 900px show them as a two-column grid of cards with the streak and the share as a side panel.

title: Done-all moment
line: When the last daily of the day is finished, the hub greets you with a short reveal (the streak counting up, afterReveal confetti) and the share button pops in - today it only appears.

title: «كلمتين في بعض»
line: Two boards side by side, two words, every guess goes on both; 7 tries for both - a harder free play for regulars, built from the same board and colours.

title: «اكتبها لصاحبك» on one phone
line: One types a word as dots (the .secret-field), hands the phone over, the other guesses - the room's set-and-solve without a room, for two on a sofa.

title: Your tries, as bars
line: The result sheet shows how many dailies you solved in 1, 2 … 6 tries (bars with scaleX, today's lit) from the dailies kept on the phone.

title: A kind chip after the 4th try
line: When the word is also in a Chameleon category, a hint shows its kind («🍎 فاكهة») after the fourth row - a gentle help from the big lists; a daily solved with it carries 💡.

title: The soft dictionary in rooms too
line: The setter's word and every solver's guess get the same phone-side «مش في قاموسنا — دوس تاني» check (the server still accepts anything) - a setter's typo stops making a round unsolvable.
warn: Decision: a written word is not checked against a dictionary (solve.md) - this only warns

title: Keys big enough for an 8-letter word
line: At 375px the Arabic keypad's 3 rows of ~11 keys are tight; for 7-8 letter words the board shrinks too - give the keys the full width (no side padding) and let the board's tiles shrink first so keys stay at least 40px tall.

title: Sideways: board beside the keys on one phone
line: Rooms already put the grid beside the keys on a phone on its side; the one-phone board at 667×375 should do the same so the keyboard and the last row are on screen together.

title: Say which letters are left
line: After each row, a short line «فاضل ٣ حروف ما جربتهاش من الحروف المشهورة» or a dot on the most common untried keys helps beginners without giving anything away.

title: «بالدور» on one phone
line: Two players alternate: on your turn pick four; a right group is yours, a wrong four hands the turn and costs the shared mistakes; most groups wins - a duel that keeps the puzzle as it is.

title: Fix: free puzzles end properly
line: connectSettle in JS_Connections.html only throws confetti for a free puzzle; end it on soloResult too (groups, mistakes) and keep puzzles solved and perfect games per level through soloRecord.

title: Name it for a ⭐
line: Before a correct group locks, an optional quick pick of its category from three names gives a ⭐ - a reason to think about the link, not just the four.

title: Long-press a tile to read it
line: A long press shows the word big in a bubble above the finger - for the long words a 375px tile cuts or shrinks.

title: The selected four, counted
line: While picking, the Submit button says «٣ من ٤» and only lights at four; the selected tiles lift slightly - today a fourth tap on a different tile is the only feedback.

title: Mistakes as dots near the submit
line: Put the four mistake dots right next to «تأكيد» and drop one with a small fall on a miss, so the cost is where the finger is, at 375px and sideways.

title: Wider tiles on a laptop
line: From 900px the grid can be wider than a form; let it take 48rem so 5-group hard boards show their words without wrapping.

title: «كل الاحتمالات» in one tap
line: A button fills every empty cell's notes with its candidates (and keeps them cleaned as numbers go in); the result says it was used, but it's no hint - a hard grid stops being a typing job.

title: Three hearts
line: A «٣ غلطات» switch: the third wrong number ends the game - a tenser way that gives mistakes a meaning.

title: «سودوكو المجموع»
line: A way inside the card: cages with sums instead of givens (killer), made with the same generator and counter - a new puzzle for the ones who finished hard.

title: Your three times
line: The result shows your last three times on this level beside the best, the new one sliding into place - progress you can see, not only a record.

title: Count on the number pad
line: Under each digit key a small «باقي ٣», and a key fades once all nine are placed - no more scanning the grid for the last 7.

title: Notes mode you can see
line: When notes are on, the selected cell and the keypad turn a different tint (the accent soft) and the keys show small digits - today only the notes button changes to primary.

title: Sideways: pad in a 3×3
line: At 667×375 lay the digits out as a 3×3 block beside the board (like a phone keypad), so they stay big instead of a long thin row.

title: «سلّم الحاجات» faces
line: A switch draws each tile as a step of a ladder - 🥚 → 🐣 → 🐥 → 🐔 → 🦚 … - our own skin (different from coins), with the number small in the corner.

title: Eastern Arabic numerals on the tiles
line: ٢ ٤ ٨ … ٢٠٤٨ under the Arabic interface (a switch), sized by the same --g2048-fs.

title: «حجر» tiles
line: A way where every 40 moves a stone tile drops that can't merge and leaves only when two 128s merge next to it - breaks the corner routine.

title: The game in numbers
line: The result adds moves, the biggest single merge and how long you held the corner, counting up - a story of the game, not just a score.

title: First game: a swipe hint
line: The very first board shows a hand swiping across it once (motion only, gone on the first move), since nothing on the screen says to swipe.

title: Score and best that react
line: A merge's points rise from the merged tile to the score (+16) and the best chip glows when passed - today the numbers change quietly.

title: 5×5 on a phone on its side
line: At 667×375 the 5×5 board is sized off the height and the buttons sit beside it; check the 5×5 numbers (4096) don't clip at that size with --g2048-fs.

title: «كانت محلولة» after a loss
line: On a mine, the no-guess solver shows one cell that was provably safe at that moment and the numbers that prove it - the loss becomes a lesson.

title: 🔍 zoom for hard fields
line: A magnifier toggle shows the field at 1.5× with one-finger panning and taps still opening cells - the answer to pinch-zoom being off.
warn: Pinch-zoom stays off (30 Sep 2026)

title: «من غير أعلام» badge
line: Clear the field without placing a single flag and the result stamps 🏳️ - a style goal for experts.

title: Custom field
line: «مخصص» under the levels: width, height and mines on steppers (still no-guess, capped where minesSolvable stays fast).

title: Flag mode you can't forget
line: With 🚩 mode on, the board gets a red edge and the button says «بتعلّم دلوقتي» - today a tap meant to open a cell often flags it.

title: Mines left, big
line: The mines-left count sits beside the clock as a big metric that pops on each flag; at 375px it is easy to lose in the bar.

title: Long-press feedback
line: A ring fills under the finger during the long press, so the flag doesn't feel random and an early lift is understood.

title: Region patterns
line: A switch adds a faint pattern or letter per region (dots, stripes…), so colour-blind players and dark mode in a bright room can tell regions apart.

title: «تاجين» - two crowns each
line: A way inside the card: two crowns per row, column and region on a 10×10 board, made by the same place/grow/solve loop.

title: «تلاتية» - three in a row
line: Three easy boards back to back on one clock, the total time as its own best - a short session goal.

title: Kids' 5×5
line: A «صغيرين» size of 5 with big cells and the rule shown as pictures on the board's side.

title: Rules as three icons on the board
line: The rule line (queens_hint) is text under the board; show three small icons above it - one per row/column, one per colour, no touching - and light the one a red crown breaks.

title: Region borders thicker
line: Draw region borders with a 2px ink line (cells 1px) so regions read even before colour does, at 375px and on a TV.

title: Sunrise to night on a win
line: When solved, the board turns into a little sky: the suns rise and glow, the moons dim to night, then the result - the reward drawn in the game's own pictures.

title: «من غير علامات»
line: A level with no =/× signs, only given cells (still solvable by tangoDeduce) - a different kind of thinking.

title: «تحدي التلات دقايق»
line: As many easy boards as you can in three minutes of play, a count and a best - a quick morning run.

title: «حل نضيف» badge
line: A board solved with no undo, no hint and no wrong line stamps ☀️🌙 «نضيف» on the result and the daily share - a quiet goal for regulars.

title: Line counts at the edge
line: A small «☀️2 🌙3» at the end of each row and column, red when over three - the most common mistake visible at once.

title: A finished line ticks
line: A row or column that is full and valid gets a soft tick and ripple, like Sudoku's - today only the whole board finishing says anything.

title: Signs readable in dark
line: The = and × between cells are small; give them a chip background on --surface-2 so they read in dark mode and at 375px.

title: «ارسمها لحد» - a picture for the family
line: Draw an 8×8 picture, the app checks it is solvable and makes a link (the cells in the address, nothing personal) - grandma solves the picture her grandson drew.

title: Count bubble while dragging
line: While a drag paints, a bubble above the finger says how many cells (٣) - the most common miscount gone.

title: Hearts mode
line: A switch: painting a cell that isn't in the picture costs a heart, three hearts - the puzzle as a tense game for those who like it.

title: Cross a clue by hand
line: Tap a single clue number to strike it (the player's own bookkeeping), as on paper.

title: Row and column under the finger
line: Highlight the row and column being painted and their clues, so on a 10×10 at 375px you know which clue you are working on.

title: Mode switch beside the board
line: ⬛/✕ as a big two-way switch next to the board (thumb reach), and the current mode shown on the cursor cell - today the mode is easy to forget.

title: A heart back for five in a row
line: Five right in a row gives back one lost heart (never above three), with the heart flying back into its place - a reason to keep going after a slip.

title: «راجع غلطاتك»
line: The result lists the questions you missed with the right answers - learning, and a laugh with whoever is next to you.

title: «سؤال الجايزة»
line: Every tenth question is a gold card worth triple, announced with a short flip - peaks in a long run.

title: Time by the question
line: Emoji riddles 15 s, proverbs 20, long trivia 25 - the ring is fair to what you have to read.

title: The right answer, clearly, before the next
line: After a wrong tap the right tile turns green but the next question comes fast; hold the reveal until a tap «اللي بعده» on a miss so it can be read.

title: Score chip counts up
line: The score chip should count up and pulse on each right answer, and the 🔥 run length show beside it from 3.

title: «راهن»
line: Before each new word you may bet 1-3 that you'll get it on this word; right wins the bet on top, wrong loses it - a decision every round.

title: Rounds from the Connections groups
line: Free play may also deal Connections' groups (four words and their category) as rounds, with decoys from other groups - many more answers from a big bank already there.

title: «لحد ما تغلط»
line: An endless way: rounds go on until a round that needs all five words - a best run kept.

title: Wrong choices tumble away
line: A wrong category falls out and the remaining choices close the gap with flipGrid, so the board tightens as clues come.

title: Points at stake, visible
line: Show «دلوقتي بـ ٤ نقط» as five dots that empty as words open - the point value is the whole tension and is easy to miss.

title: Six choices on a phone on its side
line: At 667×375 put the words on one side and the six choices as a 2×3 grid on the other, so no scroll is needed to answer.

title: «كلمة السر» from the leftovers
line: The filler letters, read in order once every word is found, spell one more word of the category - the classic magazine word-search ending, found as a last bonus.

title: Bending words on «خبير»
line: A level where words turn corners (a snake path), traced cell by cell - a different puzzle for experts.

title: «على راحتك»
line: A switch that hides the clock and keeps no time best - for relaxing with tea.

title: Second hint shows the ends
line: Tapping 💡 again on a word that already has its first letter lights its last letter too, before any third word is hinted.

title: The line follows the finger
line: While tracing, draw the selection as a thick rounded band in the accent with the word so far in a bubble above the grid - on a 9×9 at 375px the finger hides the letters.

title: Slots sized to the word
line: The list of slots shows each word's length as boxes; on a phone keep them in two columns under the grid so the grid stays big, and on a laptop beside it.

title: The big word counts double
line: Finding the base word (all the letters) lights a 🏆 and doubles that word's points - the moment everyone hunts for.

title: «بالدور» on one phone
line: Two players alternate words; each found word fills in the crossword in its finder's colour; most letters wins.

title: «دقيقتين»
line: A timed way: as many words as you can in two minutes of play, bonus included, a best kept.

title: Fix: exit within the screen upright
line: The 1 Oct note says the exit under the tools may need a scroll on 375×667; fold «خروج» into the tools row (as a small ghost icon button) so the whole play screen fits.

title: Word being built, bigger
line: The typed word above the wheel should be large and centred, shake on a refusal and fly to its slot on a hit - feedback where the eye is.

title: Bonus list on the result
line: The result shows the bonus words found and a few missed ones from the dictionary, so «⭐ ٣» means something.

title: «مين أقرب» on one phone
line: 2-4 players, one country a round by distance: each types one guess in turn (hidden), then all pins drop together and the closest scores; five rounds, a podium.

title: «رحلتك» on the map
line: After a win, a dotted line draws from your first pin to the next and on to the gold one - the route of your thinking, shared as a picture.

title: Tour best by continent
line: The tour keeps a second best: the most continents you got all right in one run, with the continent glows lit on the result map.

title: Archive days by distance
line: The archive may replay any past day's country «by distance» as practice (never counted) - same seed, new way.
warn: The daily stays «من العلم»

title: The next hint, announced
line: Under the guesses, a small line «بعد غلطة كمان: القارة» so players know a hint is coming instead of being surprised.

title: Field above the keyboard
line: On iPhone the open keyboard hides the suggestions under the field; scroll the field to the top of the screen on focus (scrollToAction) so the top suggestions are visible.

title: Callouts readable on the TV
line: The room result's map callouts are phone-sized; on the TV scale them with vmin and show only first letters on pins when more than eight overlap.

title: Fix: «استسلم» can be taken back
line: A give-up is final at once (giveUp in RoomSolve.js); hold it for 3 seconds with «رجّعني» on the phone before the server counts it (GEMINI: a button standing for something said must be take-back-able).

title: The last round counts double
line: An option: the final round's points ×2, announced on the TV with a spin (spinLetter) - nobody is out until the end.

title: Awards on the podium
line: «أسرع حل» (fastest single round), «ما استسلمش» (never gave up), «جه من ورا» (biggest climb) - named under the podium from data the server already has.

title: The table votes the next puzzle
line: In «خماسي السهرة», an option to let every phone vote between two puzzles for the next round (renderVoteResults) instead of the host's line-up.
warn: «خماسي السهرة»: the app draws the line-up and the host swaps

title: Latecomers practise the round
line: Someone who joins mid-round gets the same puzzle unscored («تمرين») so they aren't just watching.

title: Done? Know where you stand
line: The done card on a phone should say the place big («التاني ✅ 1:42») and the closing countdown, not just «خلصت».

title: Progress strip on a phone on its side
line: Sideways, the progress rows take space from the board; collapse them into one line of initials with mini bars across the top.

title: «خمّن السنة» plug-in
line: A fifth kind on the engine: the setter (or the race) picks an event from TimelineEvents and everyone guesses its year with higher/lower and the hot-or-cold bands - a big existing list, a family history quiz.

title: The setter teases
line: While the others solve, the setter can send reactions (😏 🤭 😬) that appear on the TV beside the player's card - the setter is part of the show, not waiting.

title: «أصعب لغز الليلة»
line: At game over, the secret that took the most tries is crowned with its setter's name and revealed again - a prize for setting well.

title: One extra hint from the setter
line: Once per round the setter can send a typed hint (refused if it spells the answer) to all solvers, at the cost of their own points for that round.

title: A soft check for the setter's word
