line: The setter's Wordle word goes through the soft dictionary: «مش في قاموسنا — متأكد؟» and a second tap sends it.
warn: Decision: a written word is not checked against a dictionary - soft only

title: Setter's screen while waiting
line: The setter's phone shows the secret and everyone's progress as small boards with motion as they move, plus «هيخلصوا في…» from the clock - today it's a quiet list.

title: Whose turn to set, ahead
line: The result card says «اللي عليه الدور يكتب: سارة» before «اللي بعده», so the next setter is ready and the TV shows it too.

title: «كلماتنا» in the race
line: The race's category list gains the family's packs (as خيوط did): their names and jokes become the words to guess, with the pack's name as the hint.

title: 3-6 on one phone, round the table
line: Each writes a word for the player on their left, the phone goes round, the tally is everyone's points with a podium at the end.
warn: Spec: two on one phone (22 Sep 2026)

title: «اتكتبت غلط؟» for 5 seconds
line: After «جاهزة», the writer has five seconds to take the word back and fix it before anyone guesses - a take-back like القنبلة's sendBack.

title: The table's letters on the TV
line: At a word's result the TV shows which letters the table tried most as bars (renderVoteResults) - «الكل جرّب ل الأول!» - a laugh and a lesson.

title: «أحسن كلمة» award
line: After each written word, guessers tap 👍 or 😤 (fair or unfair); at game over the writer with the most 👍 gets «أحسن كاتب» on the podium.

title: Writer's screen: pick the look sheet
line: The writer's step on one phone is waiting on the owner's pick (4 Oct sheet, look A); until then on 375×667 the hint sits under «جاهزة» - at least move «جاهزة» after the hint field.
warn: Waiting on the owner's pick (4 Oct 2026)

title: Keys tried, grouped
line: Wrong letters show as dots and under them; on a phone on its side put the tried letters as a struck row above the keys so the keys keep their size.

title: Captain clearly marked
line: In the team way, the captain's phone gets a 🧢 banner «إنت الكابتن — دوس الحرف» and the others' keys look disabled with «الكابتن بس اللي بيدوس» shown before a refused tap.

title: Search that knows how people ask
line: applyHomeFilter's haystack adds the section's own title («ورق وطاولة», «كلمات ورسم وتمثيل») and the game's GAME_RULES text (as the Help search already does), so «ورق» finds سكرو, أونو and الشايب and «رسم» finds every drawing game.

title: An empty search that still helps
line: When nothing matches, #home-empty offers two buttons instead of a bare line: «🎲 الليلة دي؟» and «📘 دوّر في القوانين» (opens Help with the same words already in its search).

title: «جديد» on a new game's poster
line: An `added` date on the GAME_LIST entry draws a small amber «جديد» ribbon on the poster (and the recent tile) for 14 days, the first time a phone sees it after a release; nothing to look after, it simply expires.

title: «كمّل» with more than one board
line: When two or more boards are still going, the «كمّل» card carries a «+2» pill that unfolds a short list (icon, name, its line) under it, so yesterday's لودو isn't lost behind today's سودوكو.

title: Counts on the filter chips
line: Each chip shows how many games it leaves («📱 موبايل واحد 34»), counted the way applyHomeFilter decides, and a chip that would leave none is dimmed - the table sees the choice before tapping.

title: A laptop or TV says «اعرضها على الشاشة»
line: A first visit 1280px wide and up, which is almost always a screen for the room, gets a big «📺 دي الشاشة؟ اعرض غرفة» card beside the three start cards (roomOpenScreen), instead of the phone's «كل واحد بموبايله» button first.
warn: Simpler to start playing (26 Sep 2026): the first visit's three cards and one room button stay; this only adds a card on big screens

title: The recent tile says when
line: Under each recent tile's name a quiet «امبارح» / «من ٣ أيام» (from the stamps homeContMark already keeps), so a family can tell what they really played last weekend.

title: Tap the title to go to the top
line: A tap on #app-title glides .shell__main to the top (scrollToAction), the way the iPhone's status bar does for ordinary pages - which can't work here because the page itself never scrolls.

title: Tap the lit tab again
line: Tapping الرئيسية while on the home glides to the top and, if a search or chip is on, clears it through flipGrid instead of redrawing; on الأدوات and مع بعض it just goes to the top - the habit every phone app has taught.

title: The room banner says «دورك!»
line: While the phone is on another screen of the app (rules, timer, home) and roomTurnOf says the game waits on it, #active-room-banner turns amber with «🔔 دورك!» and one buzz, once per turn - today that is said only after coming back from another app.

title: A crowded header folds its quiet buttons
line: Under 400px wide, when 📁 and 💬 are both showing, 🔊 and ⚙️ fold into one «⋯» that opens a small centred menu (أصوات, الإعدادات), so a room game's title keeps its words.

title: Back to «الليلة دي؟» where it came from
line: A setup opened from the tonight sheet remembers it: its back arrow (and the phone's back) reopens the sheet with the same answers and the same three games, instead of dropping to the home.

title: Hold the back arrow to go home
line: A long press on the back arrow (deep in chess's review, a score keeper's history) goes straight home in one move, through openExitSheet when a game would be dropped; a short tap stays as it is.

title: What Start will start
line: Under «ابدأ» in the Start bar a quiet line sums up the choices: «٥ لاعبين · ٦٠ ث · ٣ جولات · أكلات», built from the remembered fields, so nobody scrolls up to check before tapping.

title: «رجّع الأصلي» and a dot on what changed
line: An option that differs from the game's default carries a small accent dot on its label, and when any does, a «↺ رجّع الأصلي» link at the foot of the options puts every one back (rememberOptions with the defaults).
warn: Choices are remembered on the phone (17 Sep 2026): kept as decided; this only shows them and offers a way back

title: Saved groups as one-tap chips
line: The saved groups sit as chips at the head of the picker («👨‍👩‍👧 العيلة 6», «💼 الشغل 4»); one tap puts exactly that group in the round, a second tap takes it out.

title: The mode switch says what each side needs
line: Under «موبايل واحد» and «كل واحد بموبايله» a small line: «موبايل واحد بيتلف» / «كل واحد محتاج نت · من ٣»; offline, the own-phones side greys out with «📶 محتاج نت» instead of failing after Start.

title: Setup in two columns on a big screen
line: From 1280px wide the hero (art, line, meta, «أول مرة؟») stands as a column at the inline start and the options and Start beside it, so the form keeps its 40rem and the screen is used - the space check would flag the empty halves today.
warn: A setup screen is a form, and has a form's width (21 Sep 2026): the form keeps 40rem; only the hero moves beside it

title: «أول مرة؟» follows the switch
line: When the switch is on «كل واحد بموبايله», the drawer's three steps are the room's steps (firstPlaySteps already takes isRoom for the lobby), so a family about to open a room reads how the room plays.

title: renderPodium learns «low wins»
line: renderPodium(state, board, { low, unit, noScore }) ranks lowest-first when asked and prints the real number; the regex patches in mgPodiumHtml, skrPodiumHtml and the tournament go, and the low-scoring score keepers (JS_CardScore.html, `!g.low`) finally end on a podium.

title: A word under the number
line: Each step's score carries its unit in small type («١٢ نقطة», «٣ ضربات», «٢ غلطة»), given by the caller through the same option, so a podium reads right to someone who didn't play.

title: «نلعب إيه بعدها؟»
line: Under a one-phone result, three posters that suit the same number of people and the same way of playing (tonightCandidates), names carried over, so the next game is one tap from the podium.

title: سهرة على موبايل واحد
line: A one-phone night board: each finished one-phone game banks 5/3/2/1 to the names in the picker, and a «🌙 السهرة» chip on the results and the home shows the evening's table and its champion, cleared after 12 hours.
warn: The night's points are one rule everywhere (30 Sep 2026): uses the same 5/3/2/1; الشلة records rooms only and is untouched

title: Podium beside the board when sideways
line: On a phone on its side and a laptop the podium and the scoreboard sit side by side, so play-again and «خروج» stay on the first screen instead of under a tall stack.
warn: The play area gets the space (21 Sep 2026): the result may take the stage once over

title: A lone winner still gets a moment
line: When only one person scored, renderPodium returns nothing and the screen shows a plain line; give it a single raised step with the crown and confetti, so the win isn't flatter than a three-way finish.

title: The timer keeps the screen on
line: Add 'timers' (while running) and 'tool-dice' to wantsWakeLock in JS_Utils.html, so the screen doesn't sleep and iOS doesn't freeze the page before the alarm.

title: The running timer in the header
line: While the general timer runs and you're elsewhere, a small rose pill under the header counts down («⏱ 3:42»), tap to go to it - like the room banner, so the pot or the break isn't forgotten.

title: «كمّل» for the card score keepers
line: Add the five play-cs-* boards to HOME_CONT (live while rounds are scored and no winner), and show «كمّل · الجولة ٤» on their icon in الأدوات, so a طرنيب sheet isn't lost after a phone call.

title: Play a sound on the TV
line: In a room, the soundboard gets a «📺 على الشاشة» switch: the sound goes through the room as an event and plays on the TV (and only there), so the زغروطة or the air horn fills the room.

title: Egyptian sounds, made in the page
line: Three more FX built with Web Audio like the rest: a طبلة roll you hold for a reveal (loops while pressed), a زغروطة trill, and a car's «تيت تيت» - nothing downloaded, offline too.

title: The timer screen in the design system
line: «تصفير» is a red .btn--danger beside Start, louder than the action itself - make it ghost; and the screen's one-off utilities (py-10, mb-6, gap-4, mt-4) go to the setup's own spacing.

title: The chess clock on tokens
line: view-play-chess is drawn with bg-gray-900, border colours and z-index 99999 inline; move it to the tokens and a named layer (--z-full), so it follows dark/light and the layer list.

title: Three groups in the sheet
line: The rows under three small heads - «الشكل» (theme, size, motion, shapes), «اللعب» (languages, your name, الشلة) and «التطبيق» (share, install, version, update) - and delete-all alone at the foot after a divider.

title: Sound and buzz
line: A row «الصوت»: شغّال / الهزة بس / مقفول, read by playSound, playFx and haptic, so a quiet table or a late night can still play; the TV keeps its own volume.
warn: notes/ideas.md (3 Oct 2026) records that the app has no sound switch; not a decision against one

title: Move my data with a code
line: «انقل بياناتك»: names, saved groups, bests, options and الشلة's code packed into one code to copy (never in a link), pasted on the other phone, the other address or the home-screen copy.

title: Offer the TV size on a TV
line: The first time the app opens 1600px wide or more, a quiet toast with a button: «شاشة كبيرة؟ كبّر الواجهة» (sets the scale through cycleUiScale's value), said once.

title: Delete everything but the names
line: The delete row opens a centred sheet with two choices: «امسح كل حاجة» and «امسح كل حاجة إلا الأسامي والمجموعات», the danger button last and held for a second - a family that wants a clean start rarely wants to retype everyone.

title: Open at the part for this way of playing
line: From a room screen, Help opens the game's card scrolled to its 📱 sub-head (from the TV, its 📺 one) with a short accent glow, the ordered steps still above.

title: Search marks the words
line: A search's hits inside the rules are wrapped in <mark> (in the accent soft colour) and the open card scrolls to the first, so «قاتلة» lands on the line about the assassin.

title: «العبها ▶» on each game in Help
line: Every game's card in the list gets a small play button at its foot (catalogOpen), so someone browsing the rules can start the game they just read.

title: «إزاي نلعب» on the TV
line: While the lobby has a game chosen, the TV's stage shows the game's three first-play steps in big type beside the QR, one after another with the motion toolkit, so the whole table reads them together.
warn: help.md: the first-play card is never on a big screen - this is a separate stage panel, not the drawer

title: Read the rules out loud
line: A «🔊 اقرا» button on a Help card reads the steps with the narrator's speech (speakPrime, as مافيا does), for a host explaining to grandparents or kids.

title: «أول مرة؟» comes back when the rules change
line: A `rulesV` number on a game's rules; when it goes up, a phone that had dismissed the drawer sees it once more, marked «في جديد», so a new rule doesn't surprise a family mid-game.

title: A room link says where it's going
line: When the page opens with ?room=, the loader's line reads «داخلين غرفة K7QM…» (the code read in the head, where SERVER_DATA.room already is), and the scene keeps it as its first line.

title: «أول مرة بس»
line: On a phone with no copy yet, a scene that runs past 6 s adds a line: «أول مرة بس بتاخد وقت · المرة الجاية هتفتح على طول», so nobody gives up on the first open.

title: A quick fade for a reload
line: Opened again within 30 minutes on the home, the intro skips the flight and fades in about a third of the time - the flight is for arriving, not for a refresh.
warn: The intro stays exactly as it is (26 Sep 2026)

title: Tips among the scene's lines
line: Mix four short tips into the scenes' twelve general lines («💡 افتح غرفة وكل واحد يلعب من موبايله», «💡 التلفزيون يبقى الشاشة»), so a slow open teaches what the app can do.

title: فانوس in Ramadan, حلاوة in the Eid
line: A small lantern swinging beside the mark during Ramadan and a sprinkle of the mark's amber dots in the Eid, worked out with Intl's islamic calendar, so it never needs updating.
warn: No seasonal packs (the improvement plan, 25 Sep 2026) and the intro stays as it is: a look on the mark, no content

title: Confirms that name the action
line: showConfirmModal(msg, cb, { yes, tone, icon }): «ابدأ من جديد», «خمّن», «استسلم»; red only when something is lost, the accent otherwise, and the icon of the thing - الحرباء's guess stops looking like a delete.

title: «رجّع» instead of «متأكد؟»
line: Light removals (a name out of the round, a saved group deleted, «كمّل» hidden) happen at once with a toast «اتشال أحمد · رجّعه» whose button undoes it - one tap fewer and no fear of the tap.

title: Toasts at the top while playing
line: Under body.in-play and body.in-room-game the stack sits under the header instead of at the foot, so a note never lands on «صح!» or a hand of cards.

title: An icon for each kind of toast
line: ✓, ⚠ and ✕ before the words of success, warning and error toasts, so the meaning reads without the colour (and for colour-blind players).

title: A failed room tap offers «تاني»
line: When a room action fails on the network, the error toast carries «جرّب تاني», which sends the same action once more with its round stamp, instead of leaving the player to find the button again.

title: Dialog buttons side by side when short
line: On a screen under 420px tall (a phone on its side) .modal-actions lays its two buttons in one row, main first, so a simple dialog never needs scrolling to reach «إلغاء».

title: Ask the browser to keep the data
line: Call navigator.storage.persist() after the first game, and on an iPhone in Safari add a line to the install sheet: «ضيفه للشاشة عشان أساميك ماتتمسحش» - the home-screen copy isn't cleared after 7 days.

title: «جاهز من غير نت ✓»
line: Once the worker has every chunk, Settings' version row says «جاهز من غير نت ✓», and while it is still fetching «بيتحمّل للعب من غير نت ٤٠/٧٢» - the worker already knows both.

title: The home knows it's offline
line: Offline, a small «📶 من غير نت» pill sits by the search, room-only posters dim with 📶, and «افتح غرفة» says «محتاج نت» instead of failing; it all comes back on the online event.

title: Names follow you to the home-screen copy
line: The install sheet's last step copies the names and groups as a code; the home-screen copy's first open (empty, standalone) offers «عندك أسامي في سفاري؟ الصق» - storage is separate on iPhone and nothing else carries them.

title: A bar inside Instagram's browser
line: When installTarget sees an in-app browser, a slim bar on every screen (once a visit, closable): «إنت فاتح من جوّه التطبيق · افتحه في المتصفح عشان يفتكر أساميك».

title: «اتحدّث» names what's new
line: After a build switched by itself, one quiet toast «اتحدّث ✨ · جديد: الليزر» (from the games whose `added` date is newer than the last build seen), with a tap opening that game.

title: See it before you send it
line: The tap opens a centred sheet with the picture itself and three buttons: «شارك», «احفظ» and «انسخ»; the share sheet comes from there.

title: Copy the picture on a laptop
line: Where navigator.canShare can't take files, «انسخ» puts the PNG on the clipboard (ClipboardItem) to paste into WhatsApp Web, instead of a download nobody finds.

title: The night's card shows the night
line: shareRoomNight adds a row of the evening's games as their icons under the board («🕵️ 🎨 💣 🃏»), and the date in words («الجمعة ٩ أكتوبر»), so the picture reads as that evening.

title: Units on the card
line: The card takes the same unit as the podium (نقطة, ضربة, ضربات) and prints it after each number; a low-wins game's champion is still row one.

title: A chat-sized card
line: With five rows or fewer the card is 1080x1350 (4:5) instead of 9:16, which WhatsApp shows whole in the chat; the tall one stays for long boards.

title: Your own row marked
line: In a room the sharer's row has a soft ring and «أنا» beside the name, so the picture sent to the family says who sent it.

title: «ده أنا» - take your own seat back
line: Joining with a name whose phone has been offline for over a minute asks «إنت منى اللي كانت هنا؟» and, on yes, gives this phone that seat (its id, night points, place in the game) instead of refusing the name; the host gets a one-line note in the chat. A dead battery or a cleared browser no longer splits a person in two.

title: A game card on مع بعض opens a room for it
line: On this tab a tap on a game's card opens a small centred sheet: «افتح غرفة لـ الجاسوس» (roomCreateFor with the game chosen) or «العبوها على موبايل واحد»; one tap less and no detour through the setup.

title: «ارجع للغرفة ABCD» on the tab itself
line: When this phone was in a room in the last 6 hours and isn't now, a slim card under the three buttons offers the way back (the join screen's lastRoom), so nobody has to know it is behind «ادخل غرفة».

title: The live count says what is being played
line: «دلوقتي ٧ لاعبين في ٣ غرف · أكتر لعبة شغالة: الجاسوس» - each room reports its game id with its count to LiveStats (no codes, no names), the tab shows the top one with its icon.

title: The how-to card without its one-off spacing
line: renderTogether puts style="margin-top: var(--sp-3)" on the «اعرف أكتر» button; give the card's stack the design system's gap (btn-stack) instead, as GEMINI.md asks.

title: Join a room as a screen from the tab in one tap
line: «افتح على الشاشة» opens a new room; a laptop meant to show a room already open has to go through «ادخل غرفة» and its ghost button. A second line under the TV button, «أو اعرض غرفة موجودة», goes straight to the boxes with the screen mode set.

title: A name that is taken says who has it
line: The join error «الاسم ده مستخدم» becomes «فيه منى في الغرفة - إنت منى تانية؟» with two buttons: «ده أنا» (the seat idea above, when offline) and «اسم تاني» opening the field with «منى ٢» suggested.

title: 🙋 «نفسي ألعب» - players wish for a game
line: In the hub every player can tap 🙋 on one game in a read-only list; the host's tiles carry «🙋 ٣» with the names on a long press, and the wishes clear when a game starts. The waiting phones get something to do and the host picks what the room wants.
warn: The host chooses every game (rooms.md: starting or choosing a game stays the host's alone) - this only informs the host.

title: The night on the people tab
line: Each person's row on «اللاعبين» carries their night points as a badge and 👑 on the leader, counted up after each game (countUp); the full table stays under the list. The host sees who is winning without scrolling past 59 games.

title: The three doors as one row
line: «🌙 برنامج السهرة», «🕵️ المهمة السرية» and the crew line become one row of three equal chips over the list on the game tab (each still opens what it opens), so the first games show above the fold at 375×667.

title: Pick your face
line: «أنت: منى ✏️» also offers a face: one of the app's drawn icons or a short emoji set, shown on lobby rows, the TV's faces and chips and the podium; the initial stays the default.

title: Players see the host's choices
line: The chosen game's card on a player's phone shows the same one-line summary the host's fold shows (lobbyOptsSummarise: «٣ جولات · ٤٥ ثانية · سهل»), read-only, so nobody asks «كام جولة؟».

title: Tap the code to copy it
line: A tap on the big code copies it alone (for reading out on a call or pasting in a chat) with a toast «اتنسخ ABCD»; today only the link can be sent.

title: The lobby's inline styles
line: Controller.html's lobby card (text-align:center) and #room-wait-note (margin:0), and the night board's centred hint, carry one-off inline styles; move them into the lobby's section of the stylesheet with tokens.

title: The host can remove a prank name
line: Today ✕ shows only for a phone that is gone; the host's name menu also offers «شيله من الغرفة» for a phone that is here, behind a confirm, for the tablet a child left joined as «بطاطس».
warn: rooms.md: kick is for an offline player; widening it is the owner's call.

title: A small QR in the corner during games
line: The strip's end carries a small QR and the code («ادخل») all through a game, so a latecomer scans it and watches until the next round; it grows for 10 s when someone asks from the host's phone.

title: «إزاي نلعبها» on the stage while the host sets up
line: Once a game is chosen and before Start, the non-host TV's stage shows the first three lines of the game's GAME_RULES as a large card beside the faces, one line popping in after another; the table learns while the host fiddles.

title: The pointer hides, the keys work
line: On room-tv the mouse pointer hides after 3 s still; a laptop host gets keys: Space/Enter for the move-on button on screen, F for ⛶, H for «لعبة تانية» (with its confirm), and a «⌨️» hint in Help.

title: Edges cut off? Pull the frame in
line: A «📐» in the TV bar cycles a safe margin (0 / 3% / 5%) on the TV frame, remembered on that device, for TVs whose stick crops the bar and the strip.

title: 🌓 off the bar on the stage
line: The lobby is always dark (the owner, 3 Oct 2026), so the theme button does nothing visible there; hide it on the lobby and keep it for the games, so a tap never seems broken.

title: The strip names the game's state
line: The chips in the strip carry the game's own marks where the server already sends them: ✓ answered, ✏️ writing, ⏳ the one the room waits on (roomTurnOf's cases on the shared state), so the sofa sees who is slow without a game drawing it.
warn: Not for hidden roles: never mark what the review of 1 Oct found leaking (مافيا's night taps).

title: An idle stage cycles
line: When the hub has sat 2 minutes with no tap, the non-host stage slowly alternates the big QR, the night's full table and the faces, so the TV in the corner keeps saying something.

title: The banner lights up on your turn
line: While this phone is on another screen and roomTurnOf names it, the banner turns the accent colour, reads «دورك! · ارسم» and buzzes once per moment; a tap goes back. Today only a hidden page is told.

title: Unread chat on the banner
line: A small «💬 2» on the banner beside the code, cleared when the chat is read, so a message from the table reaches someone reading the rules.

title: A leave confirm that says what happens
line: Mid-game the confirm reads «إنت في نص الجاسوس - دورك هيعدي، ونقط الليلة هتفضل محفوظة» with «اخرج» and «خليني»; in the lobby it stays the short one.

title: «☕ راجع حالاً» - a break
line: A player marks a break from the banner or the lobby: the faces and the TV show ☕, the next game is dealt without them, and the host's handover doesn't fire for a host on a break shorter than 10 minutes; back with one tap.
warn: rooms.md: the 20 s stand-in and the 2-minute handover are set rules.

title: The banner shows where the game is
line: «بيلعبوا الجاسوس · جولة ٣/٥» or «النتيجة ظهرت» from the shared state's round and phase, so you know whether to hurry back.

title: Back in with a slide
line: «عودة» slides the room screen in from the banner's side (the nav's direction rules) instead of a plain swap, and the banner folds up as it goes.

title: «يلا!» - nudge the one we wait on
line: The chip of the person the game waits on carries a small 👉; a tap sends a nudge (one per phone per 20 s) that shows their «دورك!» banner with «منى بتقولك يلا!» and a buzz. Useful most when the table isn't one table.

title: React to a message
line: A long press on a message offers 😂 ❤️ 👏 😮; the counts sit under it (room-level, like the chat itself), so a joke gets laughs without filling the list.

title: The chat as a ticker on the TV
line: A host switch «الشات على الشاشة» (off by default) runs new messages along the TV's strip for 6 s each, never team lines; for a night with a cousin playing from abroad.
warn: rooms.md: the TV never shows the chat - a switch, off by default.

title: Quick lines that fit the moment
line: chat_quick gets three sets - the lobby («يلا نبدأ», «ثواني جاي»), a round («بسرعة!», «مش فاهم»), a result («مبروك!», «ظلم!», «تاني!») - picked from the room's phase.

title: «رسائل جديدة» line
line: Opening the sheet with unread messages draws a thin «جديد» divider above the first unread one and scrolls there, not to the bottom.

title: «دورك!» with its clock
line: When the waiting move has a deadline (endsAt in the shared state), the banner says «فاضل ١٢ث» and drains a thin bar, and stays until the turn passes instead of its fixed 5 s.

title: Those who left stay on the night
line: Project the night's names (nightx.names) with the points, and draw a leaver's row greyed with «مشي» on the board, the TV line and the share card, so a cousin who left at 11 still has her 14 points.

title: The audience bar for latecomers
line: paintAudience hides the bar on room-lobby, which is where renderRoomSpectator draws a mid-round joiner; show it there too, and make the spectator note a small live card (the game, the round, the board) instead of «جولة جارية» alone.

title: «🔮 توقعوها» on the podium
line: When a game's result shows, the people who called the winner fly in as small 🔮 chips under the podium on the phones and the TV (flyEmoji), instead of only the chat line.

title: «عرّاف الليلة» - a title, not points
line: Right guesses are counted for the night and the most shown as a small 🔮 title beside the board, never added to the 5/3/2/1.
warn: The night's points are one rule everywhere (GEMINI.md, 30 Sep 2026): a title only.

title: Live guesses on the TV
line: During the 90 s the TV strip shows «🔮 ٣» beside each player picked (the counts are already public), so the sofa sees who the crowd backs.

title: A night keeps its games
line: The phone remembers which games the night played (from the started events) beside its board; the share card gets a row of their icons («لعبنا: 🕵️ 🎨 🧠»), and a tap on a past night in أرقامي opens its table and games.

title: «آخر مرة» - the rematch line
line: When three or more names in the lobby match a past night on this phone (folded), the hub says «آخر سهرة مع بعض (١٢ سبتمبر): منى كسبت» - a reason to want revenge, from ليالينا alone.

title: The table after every game
line: Back in the hub after a finished game, phones and the TV show the night's table for 8 s first: rows rise, points count up with ▲ +5 (the program's «لوحة المذيع», compact), then the list; a tap skips it.

title: «لعبناها» on the tiles
line: Hub tiles of games played tonight carry a small ✓ (×2 for twice), and the last one played sits first with «تاني؟», so the host varies the night at a glance.

title: «تاني!» votes on the result
line: Players tap 👍 «تاني» on the result screen; the host's «العب تاني» shows «(٤ 👍)», and the TV shows the hands up.

title: A host away in the hub
line: When the host has been away 20 s in the hub, a stand-in may choose a game (not start a program or change the crew), as the move-on buttons already work mid-game.
warn: rooms.md: choosing a game stays the host's alone; the owner's call.

title: The return toast says what changed
line: «room_game_ended» becomes a short card: «المضيف رجّعنا للقائمة · منى +٥ الليلة» from the night's change, so a player's screen swap has a reason and a result.

title: The game splash with its goal
line: playRoomGameStart's splash adds the game's one-line catalog description under its name on the phones and big on the TV, held 1.5 s, so the round starts with everyone knowing the aim.

title: A share message that invites
line: The text becomes «منى فتحت غرفة 🕵️ الجاسوس - ادخل بالكود ABCD» plus the game's one-line description, built on the phone from the host's name and the catalog; nothing new on the server.

title: A closed room says so kindly
line: A link whose room is gone opens a centred card: «الغرفة دي قفلت 🌙» with «افتح غرفة جديدة» first and, if this phone was in it, the night's last table from ليالينا.

title: «ابعت لينك الشاشة»
line: The lobby's invite also offers a screen link (/r/CODE?tv=1) that opens straight as the room's big screen - send it to WhatsApp Web on the laptop, no typing on a TV remote.

title: A button on the /r page
line: The page shows the code big and an «ادخل الغرفة» button to /?room=CODE under its redirect, so a webview that blocks the refresh still has something to tap.

title: A program or crew night in the preview
line: A link shared from a room running برنامج السهرة or opened «للشلة» carries ?p=1 / the crew flag, and the title says «سهرة الليلة: ٥ ألعاب» or «سهرة الشلة» instead of one game.

title: «مين ناقص؟» on a crew night
line: In a room opened «للشلة», the crew's members not here yet show greyed under the people with «ابعتله اللينك» (the share sheet with the room link).

title: «عندي مسابقة» - bring your quiz
line: A player with a saved quiz (with its code) taps «عندي مسابقة» in the lobby; it appears in the host's «الأسئلة» list as «مسابقة سارة» (the code passed server-side, never shown to phones).
warn: quiz.md: the code stays off the phones; send it to the server, not the host.

title: Named programs
line: The builder keeps several line-ups by name («سهرة العيلة», «سهرة الصحاب»), the door offering the last three, instead of one draft.

title: «٣/٥» while a program plays
line: A small «🌙 ٣/٥» in the TV bar's title and the phones' room header during a program's games (not floating over the game), a tap showing the line-up.
warn: program.md: nothing floats over a game being played - kept inside the bar.

title: The program's share card shows the night
line: «ابعت صورة السهرة» adds the line-up as a row of game icons with each game's winner under it.

title: The program builder on a TV host
line: Notes say only a phone host was looked at; check the sheet at 1280×720 and 1920×1080 (drag handles, the picker's search with no keyboard) and give a TV host big rows and arrow keys.
